docs.text: ​全部​在​ 2026-11-21 ​查閱​。​模型​的​相容性​和​授權​每月​可能​變動​，​原型​ 02 ​開工前​要​重查​：MelodyT5、AccoMontage、AccoMontage2、Polyffusion ​的​安裝​相依​，​以及​ D3PIA ​是否​公開​程式​碼​。​能力​和​評​估類​的​說法​，2027-02 ​前​重查​。

docs.title: Digest: Symbolic accompaniment generation (melody + chords -> piano), round 1, part 1
docs.text: Accessed 2026-11-21. Every finding comes from a source retrieved in this run. Mac/CPU notes come from README text only. I did not grep the code for hard-coded .cuda() (marked "not code-checked").

docs.title: Findings
docs.text:
1. Claim: FGG ("Efficient Fine-Grained Guidance for Diffusion Model Based Symbolic Music Generation", Zhu, Liu, Wang, Jiang, Zheng) generates 4-bar piano-roll accompaniment from melody + chords (rhythm condition optional). At sampling time it applies a hard control that suppresses out-of-key/out-of-chord pitches. Trained on POP909 (15,761 four-bar segments).
  2. URL: https://arxiv.org/html/2410.08435 | arXiv (v3) | 2025-06-06 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class capability
  3. Claim: FGG reports these results vs WholeSongGen vs GETMusic. Out-of-key steps: 0.0% / 2.1% / 3.5%. Chord accuracy: 0.485 / 0.314 / 0.153. Chord similarity (VAE latent cosine): 0.767 / 0.611 / 0.394. The listening test used 6 melodies with 4 conditions each, rated by experienced listeners on harmony, naturalness, overall quality and more; FGG rated best. The 0% out-of-key figure follows from the constraint by construction.
  4. URL: https://arxiv.org/html/2410.08435 | arXiv | 2025-06-06 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class evaluation
  5. Claim: The FGG code is at github.com/huajianduzhuo-code/FGG-music-code and the README cites it as ICML 2025. Checkpoints are linked via download_link.txt, and a separate-melody/accompaniment mode conditions on chords + melody. No LICENSE was visible, and the README does not document importing a user MIDI (only notebooks generation.ipynb and generation_style.ipynb).
  6. URL: https://github.com/huajianduzhuo-code/FGG-music-code | GitHub | n/a | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf med | class licence
  7. Claim: D3PIA (Choi, Kim, Bang, Kwon, Nam, KAIST; ICASSP 2026) is a discrete denoising diffusion model with a Neighborhood-Attention lead-sheet encoder. Its input is a lead-sheet piano roll (melody + chord pitches) and its output is an 8-bar, 88-key accompaniment piano roll without velocity. It has 2.2M params and takes about 1.7 s per 8 bars. Trained on POP909.
  8. URL: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.03523 ; https://jech2.github.io/D3PIA/ | arXiv / project page | 2026-02-03 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class capability
  9. Claim: D3PIA benchmark on the POP909 test set (905 segments), reporting OOK / chord accuracy / chord similarity:
  10. Polyffusion: 0.0 / 37.5 / 54.0
  11. C&E-Embellish: 14.8 / 58.1 / 70.6
  12. D3PIA: 0.0 / 80.1 / 93.6
  13. WSG-4th: 2.4 / 87.6 / 94.6
  14. FGG: 0.0 / 62.0 / 77.3

WSG-4th and FGG use extra inputs. The listening test had 13 expert participants (piano/composition degree) rating 10 excerpts; D3PIA rated highest. WSG had higher chord accuracy but lower perceived harmony, attributed to dissonant notes. The comparison therefore shows that chord accuracy does not equal perceived harmony. - URL: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.03523 | arXiv | 2026-02-03 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class evaluation 6. Claim: The paper says D3PIA training code and samples are public at the project page, but the page as retrieved showed no GitHub, weights or licence link. - URL: https://jech2.github.io/D3PIA/ | project page | n/a | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf med | class licence 7. Claim: Whole-song hierarchical generation (Wang, Min, Xia, ICLR 2024) is MIT-licensed. Only a portion of the checkpoints is released ("sufficient for testing"). The CLI takes a form string + key. It has 2 commits, the last status note is dated Apr-03-2024, and there are 3 open issues. - URL: https://github.com/ZZWaang/whole-song-gen | GitHub | 2024-04-03 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class licence 8. Claim: AccoMontage (Zhao & Xia, ISMIR 2021) is MIT-licensed. It is phrase-retrieval + style-transfer arrangement from a POP909 phrase bank, and takes MIDI with a melody track + chords (1-beat chord granularity, 9th chords allowed). It offers velocity/pedal control and 1-16-bar phrases. Data + checkpoints are on Google Drive (updated 2024-02-27), with a Colab notebook. No CUDA mention in the README. - URL: https://github.com/zhaojw1998/AccoMontage | GitHub | 2024-02-27 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class capability 9. Claim: AccoMontage2 (Yi, Hu, Zhao, Xia, ISMIR 2022) is MIT-licensed. From a melody MIDI + tonic + mode + phrase segmentation string, it does both harmonization and accompaniment. Chord styles are pop_standard / pop_complex / r&b / dark, plus texture prefilters for rhythmic density and voice number (0-4). Outputs are chord_gen.mid, a JSON log and textured_chord_gen.mid. It is 4/4 only with 4- or 8-bar phrases, and ships a Flask GUI. It has 170 stars and 5 open issues. - URL: https://github.com/billyblu2000/AccoMontage2 | GitHub | n/a | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class capability 10. Claim: The zhaojw1998/AccoMontage-3 URL resolves to "Structured-Arrangement-Code" (Zhao et al., NeurIPS 2024, arXiv 2310.16334). Stage 1 is lead sheet -> piano accompaniment; stage 2 is piano -> multitrack. It is MIT-licensed with checkpoints on Google Drive. It pins PyTorch 1.10.1+cu111 and Python ≤3.9. The prior was trained on LMD and the autoencoder on Slakh2100. - URL: https://github.com/zhaojw1998/AccoMontage-3 | GitHub | 2024-10-28 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class compat 11. Claim: Polyffusion (Min, Jiang, Xia, Zhao, ISMIR 2023) is MIT-licensed with checkpoints on SharePoint. It supports chord conditioning (latent or vanilla), texture conditioning and melody->accompaniment inpainting (--inpaint_type=above), optionally with chords from another MIDI. Trained on POP909. No device mention in the README. - URL: https://github.com/aik2mlj/polyffusion | GitHub | n/a | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class capability 12. Claim: GETMusic (microsoft/muzic) pins torch 1.12.1+cu113 and lists no checkpoint download location in the README. Chords are inferred from the input tracks, and interactive chord-progression input is not released. Training data is unreleased (crawled pop). There are 101 open issues. The muzic repo was archived on 2026-10-01. - URL: https://github.com/microsoft/muzic/tree/main/getmusic | GitHub | 2026-10-01 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class ecosystem 13. Claim: Compose & Embellish (Wu & Yang, ICASSP 2023) is MIT-licensed with weights on HF (slseanwu/compose-and-embellish-pop1k7). The Embellish stage generates a piano performance conditioned on a lead sheet (melody + chords). Trained on Pop1K7. It recommends CUDA 10.2, and the last changelog entry is 2024-07-29. - URL: https://github.com/slSeanWU/Compose_and_Embellish | GitHub | 2024-07-29 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class licence 14. Claim: FIGARO is MIT-licensed with a downloadable checkpoints.zip of about 2.3 GB. Its controls are expert descriptions (instruments, chords, meta) plus a learned VQ-VAE description. Trained on LMD with a 32-bar default cap. It is multi-instrument and not melody-conditioned. - URL: https://github.com/dvruette/figaro | GitHub | n/a | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf med | class capability 15. Claim: "Structure-Aware Piano Accompaniment via Style Planning and Dataset-Aligned Pattern Retrieval" (Zang, Yu, Yu; arXiv 2602.15074, Feb 2026) works as follows: - A 4-layer transformer plans 6 measure-level style slots, with 15 optional keywords (e.g. alberti, stride). - It retrieves POP909 measures, reharmonizes them, and picks one by minimizing an energy over harmonic fit, voice leading, style and repetition, then samples from the top candidates. This is effectively retrieve-and-rank. - There is no code, no listening test and no note-level baselines. A demo page has 60 MIDIs. - URL: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.15074v1 | arXiv | 2026-02-16 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf high | class capability 16. Claim: These harmonic-consistency metrics are in use: - chord-tone to non-chord-tone ratio (CTnCTR) - Pitch Consonance Score (PCS) - Melody-Chord Tonal Distance (MCTD) - note-in-chord ratio (ReaLchords) - consonant/dissonant overlap ratios between melody and accompaniment (2026 live-jamming paper) - out-of-key ratio (OOK), rule-based chord accuracy and chord-embedding similarity (FGG, D3PIA)

I saw these only in search snippets for the harmonization/jamming papers; I did not read those papers in full.
- URL: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2001.02360 ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.14723 ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2606.11886 | arXiv | 2020 / 2025 / 2026 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf med | class evaluation
  1. Claim: The AccoMontage2 listening test rated harmonicity on a 5-point scale. It was significantly better than a BLSTM baseline and below the original human harmonization (snippet only).
    • URL: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2209.00353 | arXiv | 2022 | accessed 2026-11-21 | conf med | class evaluation

docs.title: Leads worth chasing
docs.text:
• D3PIA code: look for a GitHub repo by jech2 / KAIST MAC lab. It is the strongest 2026 POP909 result and tiny, so it fits the Mac. Check its licence and weights.
  • FGG repo LICENSE file and MIDI-input path. Its hard control (masking non-chord/out-of-key pitches) is directly reusable as a constraint on any piano-roll diffusion model.
  • "Learning Music Style for Piano Arrangement Through Cross-Modal Bootstrapping" (arXiv 2608.03050, 2026). Seen only in a reference list.
  • Etude (arXiv 2509.16522): piano cover in three stages. Piano2Pop (arXiv 2610.31510). STAGE (ISMIR 2025, zenodo 17706555): stemmed accompaniment with prefix conditioning. MIDI-SAG (arXiv 2602.22029): audio output.
  • ReaLchords (arXiv 2506.14723): online chord accompaniment with an RL reward on note-in-chord. Its reward/metric is reusable for ranking.
  • "Incorporating Structure and Chord Constraints in Symbolic Transformer-based Melodic Harmonization" (arXiv 2512.07627). Relevant to the chord-assignment stage.
  • Function alignment (Jiang et al., ISMIR 2025, arXiv 2506.15548). Music-for-music seq2seq with public weights; tasks include chord recognition and melody/drum generation, not confirmed for piano accompaniment.
  • Generate-and-rank recipe: sample N accompaniments (Polyffusion, FGG or D3PIA), then score each with chord accuracy against the target chords, OOK, and the melody-accompaniment consonant-overlap ratio. Penalize the dissonance that D3PIA's listeners flagged in WSG. No published system was found that does exactly this for piano accompaniment. The pattern-retrieval paper's energy function is the closest.

docs.title: Digest: Melody harmonization (melody to chords), r1-1
docs.text: Scope: open models and tools that take a symbolic melody and output chord labels, from 2019 to 2026. Accessed 2026-11-21 for every source. I used 20 tool calls. Commit dates were not visible on any GitHub page I fetched, so "last activity" is unknown unless a row says otherwise.

docs.title: Findings
docs.text: # Claim Source URL Publisher pub_date Accessed Conf. Class 1 MelodyT5 is a 113M-parameter score-to-score encoder-decoder. It works in ABC notation and has a %%harmonization task tag. The output chords are quoted ABC chord symbols, including 7ths and slash chords (inversions), e.g. "G#m7/B" and "F#7". https://github.com/sanderwood/melodyt5 ; https://arxiv.org/html/2407.02277 GitHub / arXiv (ISMIR 2024) 2024-07 2026-11-21 high capability 2 MelodyT5 code is MIT-licensed. The weights are downloadable from HF (sander-wood/melodyt5/weights.pth). The repo states no licence for the weights. https://github.com/sanderwood/melodyt5 ; https://huggingface.co/sander-wood/melodyt5 GitHub / HF 2024 2026-11-21 high (code), low (weights licence) licence 3 The MelodyT5 setup pins PyTorch 1.13.1 cu116 and Python 3.7.9, and training defaults to 8 GPUs. Mac CPU/MPS inference is not documented. At 113M parameters I expect CPU inference to be feasible, but that is unverified. https://github.com/sanderwood/melodyt5 GitHub 2024 2026-11-21 med compat 4 MelodyT5 was trained on about 42k harmonization instances from ABC Notation, JSB Chorales, The Session, FolkWiki and Nottingham. That is folk, classical chorale and Western material. No Chinese collections (e.g. ESAC) are listed. https://arxiv.org/html/2407.02277 arXiv 2024-07 2026-11-21 high capability 5 MelodyT5 versus STHarm on harmonization: CTnCTR 0.8438 vs 0.8607, PCS 0.5084 vs 0.4863, MCTD 1.0320 vs 1.0610. MelodyT5 wins on PCS and MCTD and loses on CTnCTR. An A/B listening test favoured MelodyT5, but the text gives no vote counts. https://arxiv.org/html/2407.02277 arXiv 2024-07 2026-11-21 high evaluation 6 EMO_Harmonizer (arXiv 2407.20176) does emotion-conditioned harmonization with a functional (key-relative) representation. It is pre-trained on HookTheory and fine-tuned on EMOPIA. Checkpoints are on Google Drive and output is MIDI. https://github.com/Yuer867/EMO_Harmonizer ; https://arxiv.org/html/2407.20176 GitHub / arXiv 2024-07 2026-11-21 high capability 7 EMO_Harmonizer has no LICENSE file. It requires pytorch-fast-transformers and recommends CUDA 10.2, so Mac use is doubtful because that library's CUDA/C++ build is a known pain point (unverified on Mac). https://github.com/Yuer867/EMO_Harmonizer GitHub 2024 2026-11-21 med licence / compat 8 "Pay (Cross) Attention to the Melody" (Kaliakatsos-Papakostas et al., arXiv 2601.16150, Jan 2026) is a single-encoder masked harmonizer with an FF curriculum. It is trained on HookTheory and also evaluated on jazz standards. The authors say it beats baselines on almost all metrics, with the largest gains out of domain. https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16150 arXiv 2026-01-22 2026-11-21 high capability / evaluation 9 The code for item 8 is Apache-2.0 at NeuraLLMuse/SingleEncoderMHCrossAttention. Melody input is a pitch-class pianoroll at quarter-note resolution. No pretrained weights or requirements are listed. https://github.com/NeuraLLMuse/SingleEncoderMHCrossAttention GitHub 2026 2026-11-21 high licence 10 The same group published a diffusion-inspired masked LM for harmony on a fixed time grid (Applied Sciences 15(17):9513, 2025). A search snippet says it compares against BART and GPT-2 harmonizers using CTnCTR, PCS and MCTD. The full text was blocked (HTTP 403). https://doi.org/10.3390/app15179513 MDPI 2025 2026-11-21 low evaluation 11 B* constrained decoding (beam search + A* + backtracking) forces user-given chords into the output of pretrained harmonization transformers (AIMC 2025, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16948248). The abstract does not name the models. https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07627 arXiv / AIMC 2025 2025-12-08 2026-11-21 med capability 12 rsy1026/harmonizers_transformer implements STHarm, VTHarm and rVTHarm (IEEE Access 2022). It trains on CMD and HLSD (HookTheory) and reports CHE, CC, CTR, PCS, CTD, MTD, LD, TPSD and DICD. It has no licence and no pretrained weights (you train them yourself), and the README assumes a CUDA device. https://github.com/rsy1026/harmonizers_transformer GitHub 2022 2026-11-21 high capability / licence 13 AccoMontage2 (ISMIR 2022) is MIT-licensed. It has a harmonization module that produces a chord progression from a MIDI melody, then arranges an accompaniment. It needs a tonic and mode, works only in 4/4, takes 4- or 8-bar phrase segmentation (e.g. "A8B8A8B8") and offers chord styles pop_standard, pop_complex, dark and r&b. Its chord library is a reorganized Niko dataset of 5k+ progressions. It has a Flask GUI and the README mentions no GPU. https://github.com/billyblu2000/AccoMontage2 GitHub 2022 2026-11-21 high capability / licence 14 SurpriseNet (ISMIR 2021) is a CVAE harmonizer conditioned on a user "surprise" contour and trained on the HookTheory Lead Sheet Dataset. I did not check its licence or weights. https://github.com/scmvp301135/SurpriseNet ; https://archives.ismir.net/ismir2021/paper/000012.pdf GitHub / ISMIR 2021 2026-11-21 med capability 15 Amuse (Kim, Lee, Donahue, arXiv 2412.18940) turns keywords into chords using a HookTheory chord prior plus GPT-4o and needs an OpenAI API key. It is not a melody harmonizer, so it is out of scope. https://github.com/elianakim/Amuse GitHub / arXiv 2024-12 2026-11-21 high ecosystem 16 SongComposer (ACL 2025) is an LLM for lyric-to-melody, melody-to-lyric, continuation and text-to-song. Its listed tasks include no harmonization or chord output. https://github.com/pjlab-songcomposer/songcomposer ; https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.352 GitHub / ACL 2024-02 / 2025 2026-11-21 med ecosystem 17 Yeh et al., "Automatic Melody Harmonization with Triad Chords: A Comparative Study" (JNMR 50(1)), compares template matching, HMM, a genetic algorithm and two deep models. It uses 9,226 melody/chord pairs, a 48-triad vocabulary, six objective metrics and 202 listeners. The abstract page gives no winner and no code link. It is the canonical baseline set and metric suite: CTnCTR, PCS and MCTD originate there or are reused from it (my belief, not verified). https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.02360 arXiv / JNMR 2020-01 (rev. 2021-04) 2026-11-21 high (design), low (metric origin) evaluation 18 CPFG-Net (arXiv 2511.14600, Nov 2025) is a conditional VAE that predicts perceptual features from a melody and maps them to a chord progression. I did not check code, licence or weights. https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14600 arXiv 2025-11-18 2026-11-21 med capability 19 Bitsonic Melody Harmonizer is a free, closed-source MIDI melody-to-chord plugin (VST3/AU on macOS) entered in the KVR Developer Challenge 2026. It could serve as a non-research baseline or listening reference. https://www.kvraudio.com/news/kvrdc26-bitsonic-melody-harmonizer---free-harmony-generator-plugin-for-macos-windows-and-linux-au-and-vst3-67633 KVR Audio 2026 2026-11-21 med ecosystem 20 Melodica (bivex/melodica, June 2026) is an open Python orchestral composition engine with a melody harmonizer. A forum commenter criticized its large volume of AI-generated code, so treat it as experimental. https://vi-control.net/community/threads/melodica-python-orchestral-composition-engine-with-harmonization-open-source-seeking-contributors.172916/ VI-Control forum 2026-06 2026-11-21 low ecosystem 21 The HookTheory Lead Sheet Dataset (wayne391/lead-sheet-dataset) is the common training source for HookTheory-based harmonizers (STHarm, SurpriseNet, EMO_Harmonizer, the RL harmonizer in MDPI Electronics 10(20):2469). https://github.com/wayne391/lead-sheet-dataset ; https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/10/20/2469 GitHub / MDPI 2019-2021 2026-11-21 med ecosystem

docs.title: Leads worth chasing
docs.text:
• Pick for the prototype: MelodyT5. It has open weights and an MIT code licence. Its examples output 7ths and inversions, and its ABC output can be parsed easily (e.g. with music21). It needs a modern-PyTorch/MPS smoke test and a check on the weights licence (HF card).
  • Baseline with a downstream path: AccoMontage2 gives chords plus accompaniment end to end, with a CPU GUI and MIT licence. Check its requirements.txt for Mac blockers, and check AccoMontage3.
  • Kaliakatsos-Papakostas / NeuraLLMuse group (2025-2026): look for released BART/GPT-2 harmonizer checkpoints (possibly on HF), the Zenodo record for B*, and the Applied Sciences paper (open access, try PMC/ResearchGate).
  • Check EMO_Harmonizer's paper for chord vocabulary and results, and whether pytorch-fast-transformers can be replaced with a vanilla attention layer for Mac.
  • Get the Yeh et al. comparative study's results table and find any HMM/template baseline code. It is the standard evaluation protocol; check whether metric code (CTnCTR, PCS, MCTD) is packaged anywhere.
  • Check for Chinese/East-Asian harmonization data and models, e.g. POP909-derived chord labels or Chinese pop lead sheets. None appeared in this run.
  • Check CPFG-Net and SurpriseNet repos for licences and weights.

docs.title: Looked for, could not find
docs.text:
• Any harmonizer trained on Chinese or East-Asian melody corpora (MelodyT5 explicitly lists none).
  • Commit dates for any GitHub repo (none were shown in the fetched pages).
  • Code for the Applied Sciences diffusion-inspired harmonizer (page 403) and for the Yeh et al. comparative study.
  • A rule-based harmonizer that is part of music21 or Humdrum. I did not search this directly due to budget. My belief, unverified, is that music21 offers analysis (roman numerals, chordify) but no melody-to-chord harmonizer.
  • Verification of "BART harmonization", MuPT, "Chord Melody" and CoCoMulla as melody-to-chord tools. Not reached within budget. CoCoMulla is, by my belief, chord-to-audio accompaniment (the reverse direction), which is unverified.
  • Pretrained weights for STHarm, the FF-curriculum model and Amuse (none listed).

docs.title: Lead check (lead, r1) — 2026-11-21
docs.text:
1. AccoMontage2 README: MIT licence (sidebar). Inputs: melody MIDI via set_melody; tonic mandatory; mode default major; meter 4/4 is the only supported meter; segmentation mandatory ('A8A8B8B8'), phrases 4 or 8 bars. Run: python demo.py, scripted generate_save(), GUI python back-end/app.py (localhost:5000). Needs data files from Google Drive into chorderator/static; requirements in requirments.txt (torch/CUDA not named on page). Source: https://github.com/billyblu2000/AccoMontage2 · high · capability/licence
  2. MelodyT5 HF card: licence tag MIT; weights.pth referenced; no inference hardware stated; training instructions use 8 GPUs / CUDA 11.6 builds. Source: https://huggingface.co/sander-wood/melodyt5 · high · licence (upgrades digest finding 2: weights licence now MIT per HF tag)
  3. D3PIA: search found no GitHub repo; paper says training code at jech2.github.io/D3PIA; an anonymous mirror anonymous-researcher-mir.github.io/D3PIA exists. Source: WebSearch "D3PIA piano accompaniment github" · med · ecosystem

docs.title: Digest: LLM harmonization evidence + chord-annotated melody datasets (round 1, pass 1)
docs.text: Accessed 2026-11-21 for all sources. Evidence comes only from sources retrieved this run. Most were read as abstract or landing pages, not full PDFs, so numeric detail is thin where noted.

docs.title: Q1: LLM harmonization / music-theory evidence
docs.text:
1. claim: Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash and Qwen2.5-Omni were tested on chord-quality identification, transposition detection and syncopation scoring. Models are "near ceiling" on symbolic MIDI input but drop sharply on audio. Few-shot prompting and reasoning strategies (CoT, LogicLM, where the LLM emits a machine-checkable schema run by a deterministic solver) gave minimal gains. Chord-quality accuracy was "slightly below" syncopation; the landing page gives no figures. Implication: symbolic text in works better than audio in. This is weak evidence for a text-in "conductor".
  2. source: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v303/carone26a.html | publisher: PMLR vol. 303 (Carone, Roman, Ripollés) | pub_date: 2026-01 | confidence: med (abstract-level) | class: capability
  3. claim: In an informal blog test, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Grok 4.5 Expert did Roman-numeral analysis of Bach BWV 269, Chopin Op. 9/1 and Scriabin Op. 2/1. Score images failed, while LilyPond code input worked (MusicXML is also said to be usable). Scores were Gemini 95/100/75%, Grok 80/92/40% and Opus 5 88% (the hard Scriabin case). Shared failure modes: suspensions ignored, a modulation cue (A#) missed, a secondary dominant misread as a leading-tone chord, wrong inversion. Accuracy falls as chromaticism increases. There was no comparison with music21 or other tools.
  4. source: https://aug5th.substack.com/p/llms-vs-harmonic-analysis | publisher: Augmented Fifth (Substack, "Auggie") | pub_date: 2026-08-06 | confidence: low (n=3 excerpts, single grader) | class: capability
  5. claim: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini (versions not given on the page) were tested on RCM Level 6 theory exam questions in ABC, Humdrum, MEI and MusicXML. Best result without context: ChatGPT with MEI, 52%. Best with in-context teaching: Claude with MEI, 75%. A search snippet says chord analysis improved least, while intervals, scales, transposition and cadences improved most. Encoding choice matters, and MEI was best for the best runs.
  6. source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.22853 | publisher: arXiv / CSME 2025 (Pond & Fujinaga, McGill) | pub_date: 2025-03-28 | confidence: med (headline numbers verified; chord-specific claim from snippet only) | class: evaluation
  7. claim: MSU-Bench (Musical Score Understanding Benchmark) has 1,800 generative QA pairs over complete scores (Bach to Debussy), in ABC text and PDF image modalities, at four levels from onset to texture/form. A search snippet says a harmony level covers chord analysis. More than 15 models were tested. Findings: modality gaps, unstable per-level performance, and trouble keeping correctness across levels. A snippet adds that models fail to locate specific bars, which hurts harmony questions. Fine-tuning improves results while keeping general knowledge, which conflicts with the known "trade-off" finding. Accepted at ACL 2026 Main.
  8. source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.20697 | publisher: arXiv (Dai et al., incl. Maosong Sun) | pub_date: 2025-11-24 (v4 2026-04-23) | confidence: med (model names and per-task numbers not read) | class: evaluation
  9. claim: ZIQI-Eval evaluated 16 LLMs on music comprehension and generation (theory, composition, genres, history). API models scored notably higher than open-source models. 2024 models only.
  10. source: https://arxiv.org/html/2406.15885v1 | publisher: arXiv | pub_date: 2024-06 | confidence: low (snippet only, not deeply read) | class: evaluation
  11. claim: ChatMusician / MusicTheoryBench is described as a "college-level" benchmark. ChatMusician beats LLaMA2 and GPT-3.5 "by a noticeable margin". The abstract makes no GPT-4 claim. Corpus (MusicPile), benchmark, code and model are released; their licences are not stated on the Anthology page. The paper itself is CC BY 4.0. These are 2023-era models, so this says nothing about current models.
  12. source: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-acl.373/ | publisher: ACL Findings 2024 | pub_date: 2024-08 | confidence: med | class: evaluation
  13. claim (hybrid): ComposerX is a multi-agent GPT-4 system with Melody, Harmony, Instrument and Arrangement agents. The Harmony agent adds chords and counterpoint and checks the progression against the melody's tonality, with output in ABC. It is described as the first LLM multi-agent polyphonic symbolic composition system. This is the closest prior design to an "LLM conductor".
  14. source: https://qmro.qmul.ac.uk/xmlui/bitstream/handle/123456789/98627/ (ComposerX, Deng et al., incl. Benetos) | publisher: QMUL repository / ISMIR 2024 (venue unverified) | pub_date: 2024 | confidence: low-med (search snippet, not read in full) | class: capability
  15. claim (hybrid): Libretto is a framework that gives LLM agents a grammar with explicit onset slots, voices and bars. Each piece is scored in a corpus-calibrated statistical space (rhythm, harmony, melody, texture, form, variation) used for diagnosis and self-revision. The abstract names no LLMs and reports no quantitative harmony results. The paper is CC BY 4.0.
  16. source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22708 | publisher: arXiv (Yichen Xu) | pub_date: 2026-06-21 | confidence: low | class: capability
  17. claim (hybrid): CoComposer (LLM multi-agent collaborative composition, 2025) and ByteComposer (2024, a melody-only agent pipeline) exist as further agent designs. A LLaMA 3.1 LoRA multi-task framework includes chord-progression generation and is trained on POP909.
  18. source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.00132 ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.17785 ; https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-95-9843-4_17 | publisher: arXiv / Springer | pub_date: 2025 / 2024 / 2025 | confidence: low (titles/snippets only) | class: capability
  19. claim: Search found no rigorous benchmark of a general LLM (GPT-4/5, Claude, Gemini) on melody harmonization measured against dedicated harmonizers such as AccoMontage2 or CMD-trained models. GPT-4 harmonization evidence is informal: blog and HN posts, where a commenter warns its chord output "can't be relied on".
    • source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=36497414 ; https://www.audiocipher.com/post/chatgpt-music | publisher: HN / AudioCipher | pub_date: 2023 | confidence: med (absence after two searches) | class: evaluation

docs.title: Q2: Datasets (verified items)
docs.text:
1. claim: POP909 has 909 pop songs. Each has a MIDI file with MELODY (vocal), BRIDGE (sub-melody) and PIANO (accompaniment) tracks plus alternate versions. Beat, chord and key are in time-stamped .txt files. Chords and keys come from MIR algorithms (paper: tempo hand-labelled, the rest algorithmic). The chord vocabulary includes sus, 6th, 7th and inversions. The repo is MIT-licensed (LICENSE text not quoted). This run did not verify that the songs are Chinese pop: the repo says only "pop-song dataset", and only a third-party summary says Chinese.
    • source: https://github.com/music-x-lab/POP909-Dataset ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2008.07142 | publisher: Music X Lab, NYU Shanghai / ISMIR 2020 | pub_date: 2020 | confidence: high (contents), med (licence) | class: dataset, licence
  2. claim: Hooktheory.json.gz (about 20 MB) holds 50 hours of melody and harmony annotations aligned to audio (audio not included), with artist-stratified 8:1:1 splits and tags. The data is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; the code is MIT.
    • source: https://github.com/chrisdonahue/sheetsage | publisher: Donahue, Thickstun, Liang (ISMIR 2022, arXiv 2212.01884) | pub_date: 2022 | confidence: high | class: dataset, licence
  3. claim: Chordonomicon has 679,807 rows (more than 666k songs) of chord progressions with section tags (intro, verse, chorus), genre, decade and Spotify IDs. It has no melody. CC BY-NC 4.0. CSV/Parquet on Hugging Face.
    • source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ailsntua/Chordonomicon | publisher: Kantarelis et al. (NTUA), arXiv 2410.22046 | pub_date: 2024 | confidence: high | class: dataset, licence
  4. claim: When-in-Rome holds about 2,000 Roman-numeral analyses of about 1,500 works in RomanText, with scores as MusicXML or remote links. Contents: 371 Bach chorales, Beethoven quartets (ABC/DCML, 70 movements), Mozart sonatas, Chopin mazurkas, Haydn Op. 20, BPS-FH, TAVERN, Monteverdi madrigals, WTC I preludes, and Lieder (Winterreise, Schwanengesang, Dichterliebe). New content is CC BY-SA 4.0. Externally sourced analyses keep their own licences.
    • source: https://github.com/MarkGotham/When-in-Rome | publisher: Mark Gotham et al. | pub_date: continuously updated | confidence: high | class: dataset, licence
  5. claim: Chord Melody Dataset (CMD) is jazz and standards lead sheets ("all_of_me", "blue_bossa") in MusicXML, OCR-scanned with SmartScore. It has 2 chords per 4/4 bar, a monophonic melody and no triplets. MIT licence on the repo. The count is not shown on the page; a 2025 paper says CMD is smaller than 650 pieces. The source sheets may be copyrighted songs regardless of the repo licence.
    • source: https://github.com/shiehn/chord-melody-dataset ; https://doi.org/10.3390/app15179513 | publisher: shiehn (GitHub) / MDPI Appl. Sci. 2025 | pub_date: n.d. / 2025 | confidence: med | class: dataset, licence
  6. claim: OpenGufeng is a melody-plus-chord dataset of Gufeng (Chinese-style pop) in a single key, played at four tempi. It is raw MIDI, with cleaning still a to-do. Chords are reduced to major/minor triads (per snippet). MIT licence label. No paper yet.
    • source: https://github.com/yongyizang/OpenGufeng | publisher: Yongyi Zang (GitHub) | pub_date: n.d. | confidence: med | class: dataset, licence
  7. claim: The Chinese Chorales Dataset has 125 Chinese chorales in 441 score segments with chord annotations, hosted on GitHub.
    • source: https://www.springerprofessional.de/en/chinese-chorales-dataset-a-high-quality-music-dataset-for-score-/26698008 | publisher: Springer | pub_date: ~2024 | confidence: low (snippet; licence unread) | class: dataset
  8. claim: Diao annotations cover 219 heptatonic Chinese folk melodies from Essen (diao category, gong, diao tou, pitch-class profiles). CC BY 4.0 but labelled "Dataset Restricted". These are modal labels, not chords.
    • source: https://zenodo.org/records/14607710 | publisher: Meng, Moss, Rohrmeier (Zenodo) | pub_date: 2025 | confidence: med | class: dataset, licence
  9. claim: HarmonyTok (2025) used more than 17,000 lead-sheet charts with melody and chords as separate MIDI tracks. MelodyHub (MelodyT5) has 261,900 ABC melodies, with harmonization as one of seven tasks. A curated jazz-standards harmonization set (650 pieces) is available on request only, for copyright reasons.
    • source: https://doi.org/10.3390/info16090759 ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2407.02277 ; https://doi.org/10.3390/app15179513 | publisher: MDPI Information / arXiv / MDPI | pub_date: 2025 / 2024 / 2025 | confidence: low (snippets) | class: dataset

docs.title: Leads worth chasing
docs.text:
• Read the full MSU-Bench PDF for harmony-level per-model numbers and model names (may include GPT-5 / Claude / Gemini 2.5+).
  • Read the Carone et al. PDF for chord-quality numbers on MIDI versus audio, and for the LogicLM schema, which is a model for an LLM that emits a checkable spec and a tool that executes it.
  • Read Pond & Fujinaga for per-encoding results on chord questions (ABC vs MEI vs MusicXML) to choose a prompt format.
  • ComposerX / CoComposer full text: how the Harmony agent is prompted, and whether chord-fit validation exists.
  • Verify the POP909 paper's statement on song origin (Chinese pop) and read the LICENSE text.
  • DCML corpora licence (GitHub DCMLab), Rock Corpus availability, the Nottingham cleaned version (jukedeck/nottingham-dataset) licence, the Wikifonia status.
  • FaiSonic MMD (2026-11): check for chord and melody alignment and Chinese content.
  • Chinese Chorales Dataset GitHub licence.
  • Augmented Fifth's other post, "Testing LLMs on Undergraduate Music Theory" (2025–26 models, chord spelling).

docs.title: Looked for, could not find
docs.text:
• A dedicated benchmark of general LLMs on melody harmonization (melody in, chords out) with objective metrics compared against trained harmonizers: none found in two searches.
  • A music-theory Roman-numeral benchmark specifically for LLMs: the search returned only numeracy (Roman numbers) papers.
  • A chord-annotated Chinese folk-song corpus: none found. The closest are the Essen diao (modal) labels, OpenGufeng (pop) and the Chinese Chorales Dataset.
  • Licence text for MusicPile / ChatMusician weights (not on the Anthology page).
  • Any evaluation of voice-leading quality produced by general LLMs: none found.

docs.title: Citation check: research-music-generation-tech-roadmap.md
docs.text:
Checked 2026-11-20 against the digests in digests/. I made two WebFetch calls: arXiv 2408.12658 (GaMaDHaNi venue) and github.com/EleutherAI/aria (Aria venue). The report was not edited.

Severity: H = wrong citation or unsupported load-bearing claim. M = overstatement, or peer-review/confidence status stated wrongly. L = minor precision issue or a missing secondary citation.

docs.title: Issues
docs.text: # Sev Location (section + short quote) Marker Issue Suggested fix 1 M Rec 1: 「​信心​：​高​。​零件​的​能力​和​授權​都​已​到​第一手​來源​查證​。」 [8][12][18] The licences were checked at first hand (d1d2), but not all the capabilities were. SyMuPe/PianoFlow's capability claims rest on snippets (d1 row: medium; the appendix itself gives [8] as 「​中​（​能力​）」). Aria's ISMIR 2025 status is unconfirmed: the README title says ISMIR 2025, but its BibTeX says booktitle={arXiv preprint} (fetched). Neither AMT nor Aria has fine-tuning instructions (d5). The timeline 「2 ​到​ 4 ​週​」 has no source. Downgrade to 「​中​高​」. Say that the licences were checked at first hand and the capabilities partly. Mark 2–4 weeks as the author's estimate. 2 H D3: 「​沒​找到​確認​支援​ MIDI 2.0 ​逐音​音高​的​合成器​清單​，Dorico ​和​ OpenMusic ​匯出​時​也​會​丟掉​微分​音記號​ [45]」 [45] [45] is the Steinberg forum thread on MusicXML/Dorico. The claim that no confirmed list of MIDI 2.0 per-note-pitch synths was found comes from the KVR Audio forum (d3, Q1 row 2, confidence low), which is not in the appendix. The OpenMusic claim comes from an IRCAM forum thread (d3), which is not cited either. Add the KVR thread (kvraudio.com/forum/viewtopic.php?p=8160672) and the IRCAM thread to the appendix and cite them. Keep the confidence at ​中​低​／​低​. 3 H D4: 「​主觀​的​聽覺​測驗​沒有​統一​的​實驗​程序​ [59]」 [59] The "no standardized subjective protocol" claim comes from arXiv 2308.13736 (A Comprehensive Survey for Evaluation Methodologies of AI-Generated Music, preprint, snippet only, medium; d4 Q4 row 2). [59] (Lerch et al., ACM CSUR) is recorded only as a taxonomy of evaluation methods, with confidence "high (existence)". Swap in or add arXiv 2308.13736 as a new source. Mark it as a preprint with medium confidence. This also affects the cross-cutting insights line 「​聽覺​測驗​又​沒​有​標準​程序​（D4）[59][60]」. 4 M D5: 「​訓練損​失和​ FMD ​都​不是​可靠​的​品質​指標​，​聽覺​測驗​仍然​是​基準​ [23]」 [23] [23] (arXiv 2601.22764) supports the claim about FMD only. The claim about training or validation loss comes from arXiv 2511.07268 (overfitting checkpoints sound better while validation loss worsens; d5 Q5, snippet, low-medium). Add 2511.07268 as a source for the loss half (low-medium), or drop 「​訓練​損失​」. 5 M D5: 「NotaGen-large ​微調​需要​ 24GB ​顯示​記憶體​，​較​小​的​版本​需求​更​低​，​推論​大約​ 8GB [19]」 [19] d5 says NotaGen-large needs at least 24GB, for both fine-tuning and inference, and that the roughly 8GB figure is for NotaGen-X local inference. As written, the sentence implies large-model inference fits in 8GB. Red team C1 also says 24GB is the floor. Change to 「NotaGen-large ​訓練​／​微調​與​推論​至少​需​ 24GB；NotaGen-X ​本地​推論​約​ 8GB；​較​小​版本​（110M/244M）​需求​較​低​」. 6 M D1: 「SyMuPe/PianoFlow（ACM MM'25）」 [8] d1d2 #11 says the README calls it ACM MM'25 but acceptance was not separately verified. d1 says "per snippet (unverified)". Write 「（README ​標示​ ACM MM'25，​未獨立​確認​）」. 7 M D5: 「Aria，Apache-2.0，ISMIR 2025 [18]」, and appendix [18] 「（ISMIR 2025）」 [18] d5 flags a contradiction: the README title says ISMIR 2025 and the BibTeX says preprint. A fetch on 2026-11-20 confirmed that the BibTeX says arXiv preprint. Write 「ISMIR 2025（​據​ README，​未​確認​）」. 8 M D2 table: Aria-MIDI 「​從​ YouTube ​轉錄​的​鋼琴​ MIDI」 [30] The [30] row (aria-midi README, d1d2 #17) covers only the licence and the disclaimer. The YouTube origin appears only as an inference in d2 ("YouTube-derived"). Red team C1 (arXiv 2504.15071, ICLR 2025) says "crawled from internet audio". Change to 「​從​網路​音訊​轉錄​」 and add arXiv 2504.15071 (ICLR 2025) as a source. 9 M Cross-cutting insights / Rec 4: product version 「Basic Pitch、YourMT3+、ACE-Step、PDMX」 [5][16][27] [4][16] The licences are right. But d1d2 #6 says ACE-Step 1.5's training-data provenance was not examined and is "the open risk", and #4 says YourMT3+'s training-data licences were not checked. The report raises provenance risk for AMT but presents ACE-Step as a clean commercial option. Add 「ACE-Step ​與​ YourMT3+ ​的​訓練​資料​來源​未查​證​，​商用​前​需​確認​」. 10 M Rec 3: 「​改用​授權​乾淨​的​ openvpi/DiffSinger（Apache-2.0）​作為​基礎​ [39]」 [39] gaps-r2 Lead 1 says openvpi/DiffSinger code is Apache-2.0, but its pretrained models and voicebanks may carry separate terms that were not verified. 「​授權​乾淨​」 overstates this. Change to 「​程式​碼為​ Apache-2.0（​預訓練​模型​與​聲庫​條款​未查​證​）」. 11 M Red team table, C2 row: 「​音訊轉​接器​已經能​在​沒​有​符號​層​的​情況​下​控制​節拍​和​音高​ [71][72]」 [72] JASCO (red team C2) takes symbolic chord and melody conditions directly: "Symbolic input works as a condition, not a separate generated layer." Citing it for "without a symbolic layer" misstates it. [71] DiffSynth-Music fits the sentence. Cite only [71] for 「​沒有​符號​層​」, and add a separate clause: 「JASCO ​直接​以​符號​和弦​／​旋律​作為​條件​，​而​不​另外​生成​符號​層​ [72]」. 12 L Red team table, C2 row: 「​民族​音樂學​批評​音符​類別​帶​有​歐洲​的​預設​ [75]」 [75] The "European structure" critique (Seeger, Carpitella, "categorical premisses") comes from the JRMA article Notating Deconstruction (red team C2), which is not in the appendix. [75] (Holzapfel et al., DSH 2022) says that AMT assumes Western staff notation as its target. That is related, but it is not the same claim. Add the JRMA article as a source for the European-premise point, and keep [75] for "transcription assumes staff notation". 13 M Executive summary, finding 3: 「​對​歌仔​戲​、​京劇​這類​以​滑音​為主​的​傳統​，​控制​點應​該​放在​「​音高​曲線​」…[50]」 [50] [50] (GaMaDHaNi) is about Hindustani vocal music only, and d3 notes it was not ported to jingju or Gezaixi. Applying it to ​歌仔​戲​ and ​京劇​ is the red team's inference (C2), not something [50] states. Red team C2 also cites DurIAN [76], where jingju singing synthesised from notes alone was judged comparable, which cuts against the claim. Mark it as an inference: 「​依​印度​聲樂​的​研究​推論​ [50]；​京劇​另​有​只用​音符​的​反例​ [76]」. 14 L Executive summary, finding 3: 「YuE2 ​的​專家​評分​是​ 49.3% ​對​ 34.6% [70]」 [70] The numbers match red team C2, but the source is a preprint read at abstract level only. The executive summary doesn't say so (the appendix does). Add 「（​預​印本​，​只讀​摘要​）」 to the executive summary sentence. 15 L Executive summary: 「​可以​商用​的​大型​符號​資料​只有​ PDMX [27]」 [27] D2 itself says 「​只​找到​」. The executive summary turns "only one found" into "only one exists". (Lakh is CC BY 4.0 on paper, though its underlying rights are not cleared.) Change to 「​只​找到​ PDMX」. 16 L Executive summary: 「​主要​的​演奏​資料​、​非西方​資料​和​多數​模型​權重​都​限非​商用​ [2][8][17][28]」 — None of the cited sources covers the non-Western data claim. Add [34][35][36]. 17 L Executive summary, finding 1: 「​採譜​：MuScriptor、YourMT3+、Basic Pitch [1][4][5]」 [4] [4] supports YourMT3+'s licence. Its capability source is [3]. Add [3]. 18 L D2 table: ASAP 「222 ​份樂譜​對​ 1,067 ​次​演奏​」 [31] d2 says the README's own counts disagree (222 vs 236 scores, 1,067 vs 1,068 performances). Add 「（README ​數字​不​一致​：222/236、1,067/1,068）」. 19 M D2: 「​日本​傳統​音樂​…​唯一​能​直接​拿來​做​研究​的​只有​ 9 ​段民謠​錄音​…​作者​要求​不要​公開​轉載​，​因為​內容​涉及​儀式​ [64]」 [64] (a) Access is through a request form (gaps-r2), so 「​直接​」 overstates availability. (b) The ritual-sensitivity request applies to the VocalNotes dataset as a whole (5 traditions). It is not specific to the Japanese min'yō clips. (c) The source is a search summary (medium). Change to 「​需填申​請表​取得​」 and 「​整份​資料​集含​敏感​儀式​內容​，​作者​要求​不要​重新​彙​整公開​」. 20 L D1: 「ACE-Step 1.5…​但​不輸出​ MIDI ​或樂譜​ [15][16]」 [15] d1 says only that the abstract does not mention MIDI or score output ("not mentioned"). Change to 「​摘要​未​提及​ MIDI ​或樂譜​輸出​」. 21 L D5: 「AMT ​和​ Aria ​也​沒​有​附微調​說明​，AMT ​的​作者​把​訓練導​向​另​一套​框架​ Levanter [12]」 [12] [12] covers AMT only. The Aria half needs [18] (d5). Add [18]. 22 M Staleness map: 「​授權​條款​是​在​ 2026-11-19 ​當天​到​第一手​來源​查證​的​」 [36][30][34] This is not true for all of them. The SymbTr licence comes from a snippet, and its LICENSE file was not opened (d2, d3). Only the Aria-MIDI README was read: its LICENSE and DISCLAIMER files were not (d1d2 #17, medium-high). Saraga rests on one Zenodo field (medium), and d2 earlier said the licence was not confirmed. Write 「​大部分​授權​已查​第一手​來源​；SymbTr、Saraga、Aria-MIDI ​仍為​單一​或​摘要​來源​」. 23 L Open questions: 「​只有​單一來源​…MAESTRO ​和​ Saraga ​的​授權​ [28][34]」 [33] d1d2 ("Looked for, not found") says M4Singer's licence also rests on one official page. Add M4Singer [33] to the list. 24 L D1: 「NotaGen…​這是​本​研究​唯一​找到​、​有​現成​作曲家​和​時期​控制​的​開源​模型​」 [19] d1 Lead 7 says composer and style conditioning was not searched in round 1. MIDI-GPT has a "style" attribute [20]. d5 also says NotaGen's pretrained weights cannot do prompted generation: only the fine-tuned weights can. Add 「（​僅微​調後權​重​支援​；​未系統​搜尋​其他​作曲家​條件​模型​）」. 25 L D3: 「​滑音​和​裝飾音​在​這些​格式​中​都​只能​當作​「​音符​」​處理​。」 — This is an uncited capability claim. The closest support is the VocalNotes question (IFTAWM journal, snippet, low), and d3 also lists MusicXML/SMuFL glyphs and MIDI 2.0 pitch bend, which can partly encode glides. Cite the VocalNotes IFTAWM source and soften to 「​多半​只能​當作​音符​或​裝飾​記號​處理​」.

docs.title: Checked and supported (no issue)
docs.text:
• GaMaDHaNi "ISMIR 2024" [50]: the digests disagree (gaps-r2 and red team C2 call it unverified), but a fetch confirmed the arXiv comment "Accepted at ISMIR 2024". The report is correct.
  • MuScriptor [1][2]: F1 48.2 vs 21.9, mixed per-dataset results, choral weakness, MIT code and CC BY-NC weights all match.
  • YourMT3+ [3][4]: GPL-3.0 code and Apache-2.0 weights match. Basic Pitch [5]: matches.
  • AMT [10][11][12]: Apache-2.0, the roughly 450k commercial-records transcripts, and the "presumed to risk infringing" quote all match. MusicGen [17]: matches. ACE-Step [16]: MIT matches.
  • Text2midi [13], MIDI-LLM [14], MIDI-GPT [20]: Open RAIL-M, 4×V100 for 2–3 days, and MidiTok 3.1.0 [21] all match.
  • PDMX [27]: 12.29% and 222,856 match. MAESTRO [28]: 198.7 h matches. Lakh [29]: 176k, with the inference flagged, matches.
  • Opencpop, M4Singer, CompMusic, SymbTr [32][33][35][36]: the licence strings match.
  • Gezaixi [37][38], Academia Sinica archive [65] (7 groups, 309 files), and GEMA v OpenAI and GEMA v Suno [40][41], including the single-source caveat, all match. US settlements [42]: match.
  • MIDI 2.0, MusicXML, MEI [43][44][46], gongche 39 images [47], jianpu [48], jingju a cappella 120/1,265 [49], VQ-VAE [51] and Tzanetakis [52]: match.
  • MDT [53]: Markov chain, Essen, 3 radicals, adj. R² 0.869, 1,200 items and 158/266 participants all match. CA-BAT, MPT, PROMS [54–56], AI-stimulus studies [57], Jacoby [58], IS/FAD correlations [60], nearest works [61–63] and MET [68]: match.
  • ABC-Eval [22], LLM fine-tuning trade-off [23], MuseBarControl 65.3→78.3 [24], SSIMuse [25] and motif copying [26]: match.
  • Red team rows: 87%, NotaGen pretraining sources undisclosed [19], 5.7% [74], MazzikaAI [73] and DurIAN [76] match.

docs.title: 技術​研究​：​音樂​生成​專案​的​技術​起點​與​路線​圖
docs.text: ​這份​研究​服務​的​決定​： ​樂譜​↔​音樂​雙向​轉換​，​以及​可控​、​跨文化​的​研究​素材​生成​，​該​從​哪裡​開始​？​哪些​部分​用​現成​的​、​哪些​自己​訓練​、​用​哪些​資料​、​單​旋律​ MIDI ​之​後​的​下​一步​是​什麼​？

docs.title: 執行​摘要
docs.text:
​建議​：​不要​從頭​訓練​。​先用​現成​的​開源​模型​拼出​一條​「​採譜​→​樂譜層​→​表情​演奏​」​的​流程​，​把力​氣花​在​整合​、​控制​和​評估​上​。​研究​的​切入​點選​在​「​神經​網路​生成​的​測驗題​目​＋IRT ​難度​校準​」。

​支撐​這個​建議​的​三個​發現​：

  1. ​每​一段​都​有​可以​直接​拿來​用​的​零件​，​但​沒​有人​把​它們​串起​來​。
  2. ​採譜​：MuScriptor、YourMT3+、Basic Pitch [1][3][4][5]
  3. ​給​旋律​生​伴奏​：AMT [12]
  4. ​作曲家​和​時期​控制​：NotaGen [19]
  5. ​鋼琴​表情​演奏​：SyMuPe、Aria [8][18]

​找​不到​任何​整合​這些​功能​的​開源​工具​鏈​，​而​這​正是​你​想​做​的​「​轉換​工具箱​」。 2. ​你​的​研究​問題​有​一個​經過​反方​審查​仍然​成立​的​空白​。 - ​音樂​能力​測驗​早就​在​用​自動​出題​加​ IRT，​但用​的​是​馬​可夫​鏈​，​只​控制​ 3 ​個​因子​ [53]。 - ​針對性​搜尋後​，​沒有​找到​任何​研究​用神經​網路​生成​題目​、​再用​ IRT ​校準​難度​。 - ​西方​中心​的​問題​有​實證​支持​ [58]，​所以​「​跨文化​、​可控​的​生成​題目​」​是​有​根據​的​研究​貢獻​。 3. ​雙層​架構​方向​對​，​但​要​修正​說法​。 - ​有​顯式​的​樂譜​或​規劃層​，​確實​有助​於​控制​。YuE2 ​的​專家​評分​是​ 49.3% ​對​ 34.6% [70]（​預​印本​，​只讀​摘要​）。 - ​對​歌仔​戲​、​京劇​這類​以​滑音​為主​的​傳統​，​控制​點​可能​應該​放在​「​音高​曲線​」​或​該​文化​專屬​的​符號​，​而​不是​西方​的​音符​。​這是​從​印度​聲樂​的​研究​推論​出來​的​ [50]，​京劇​另​有​只用​音符​就​合成​歌聲​的​反例​ [76]。 - ​兩層​要​分開​訓練​還是​合成​一個​模型​，​目前​還沒有​定論​。2026 ​年​的​證據​比​較​偏向​合成​一個​ [70]。

​最大​的​限制​：​資料​和​授權​。 - ​可以​商用​的​大型​符號​資料​，​只​找到​ PDMX [27]。​主要​的​演奏​資料​、​非西方​資料​和​多數​模型​權重​都​限非​商用​ [2][8][17][28][34][35][36]。 - ​歌仔​戲幾乎​沒有​可以​用​的​公開​資料​ [37][38]。 - 2026 ​年​ 7 ​月德國​法院​在​ GEMA ​對​ Suno ​案​認定​「​模型​本身​侵權​」[41]，​判決​尚未​定​讞​，​也​只有​單一來源​。 - ​結論​：​做學術​研究​可行​，​但​將來​要​做訂​閱產品​，​就​得​重新​挑選​資料​和​權重​。

docs.title: D1　​現況​：​採譜​、​表情​演奏​、​可控​生成
docs.text:
​採譜​（​音訊​→​樂譜​）​大致​可以​直接​用​現成​的​，​但​輸出​是​ MIDI，​不是​樂譜​。 - ​最新​的​開源​多樂器​採譜​模型​是​ MuScriptor（2026-08，​預​印本​）。​在​作者​自己​的​測試​集上​，​多樂器​ F1 ​是​ 48.2，YourMT3+ ​是​ 21.9。​不過​在​ Bach10、​合唱​和​古典​樂資料​集上​，YourMT3+ ​的​起音​ F1 ​比較​高​，​而且​兩者​唱​合唱​都​很​弱​ [1]（​中​信心​：​數字​是​單一來源​，​而且​來​自​競爭者​自己​的​表格​）。 - MuScriptor ​的​程式​碼是​ MIT，​權重​是​ CC BY-NC 4.0（​非​商用​） [2]。 - YourMT3+ ​的​程式​碼是​ GPL-3.0，HF ​上​的​權重​是​ Apache-2.0 [3][4]。 - Basic Pitch ​是​ Apache-2.0，​可以​商用​ [5]。 - ​鋼琴​採譜​：​最新​的​頂​尖​結果​仍​是​ 2024 ​年​的​ Transkun [6]，​沒​找到​ 2025–26 ​年​的​後​繼者​。 - ​音訊​→​可​編輯​樂譜​（MusicXML）​目前​仍要​分​兩步​：​先轉​ MIDI，​再​轉樂譜​。​已​發表​的​系統​只有​鋼琴​ [7]，​沒有​找到​通用​的​多樂器​音訊​轉樂譜​模型​。

​看譜​表情​演奏​（​樂譜​→​有​表情​的​演奏​）​研究​很​活躍​，​但​幾乎​全部​只​做​鋼琴​。 - ​最實用​的​開源​工具​是​ SyMuPe/PianoFlow（README ​標示​ ACM MM'25，​未獨立​確認​），​可以​用​情緒​文字​引導​。​它​的​程式​碼是​ Apache-2.0，​權重​和​訓練​資料​是​ CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，​論文​自己​也​說還​不能​即時​互動​ [8]。 - ​唯一​找到​的​多樂器​版本​是​ RenderBox（​預​印本​，​開放​程度​未​確認​）[9]（​低​信心​）。

​可控​的​符號​生成​：​有​可以​拿來​改​的​基礎​模型​，​各自​控制​的​面向​不同​。 - Anticipatory Music Transformer（AMT）：​可以​補寫​缺段​，​也​能​「​給​旋律​、​生​伴奏​」。README ​裡​直接​示範​了​ controls= ​的​用法​ [10][12]。​程式​碼​和​權重​都​是​ Apache-2.0，​但​大型​模型​的​訓練​資料​包含​「​約​ 45 ​萬張​商業​唱片​的​轉譜​」[11]。 - NotaGen（IJCAI 2025）：​以​「​時期​－​作曲家​－​編制​」​作為​提示​生成​ ABC ​記譜​，​程式​碼是​ MIT [19]。​這是​本​研究​唯一​找到​、​有​現成​作曲家​和​時期​控制​的​開源​模型​。​不過​只有​微調​後​的​權重​支援​這種​控制​，​而且​本​研究​沒有系​統性​地​搜尋​其他​有​作曲家​條件​的​模型​。 - Text2midi（AAAI 2025，​權重​ Apache-2.0）[13] ​和​ MIDI-LLM（Llama 3.2 ​授權​）[14]：​用​文字描述​風格​、​調性​、​速度​和​樂器​。 - MIDI-GPT：​多軌​補寫​，​加上​密度​、​複​音數​、​風格​等​屬性​控制​。​權重​是​ Open RAIL-M，​有​使用​限制​ [20]。

​音訊​生成​：​控制力​進步​很快​，​但產出​不是​樂譜​。 - ACE-Step 1.5（2026-02，MIT）​支援​風格​控制​、​翻唱​、​局部​重繪​、​給人​聲生​伴奏​和​ LoRA ​微調​；​摘要​沒有​提到​ MIDI ​或樂譜​輸出​ [15][16]。 - MusicGen ​的​權重​是​ CC BY-NC [17]。

​整合​工具​鏈​： ​沒有​找到​任何​開源​工具​同時​涵蓋​採譜​、​生成​和​演奏​（​低​信心​：​這是​「​沒​找到​」，​不是​「​確定​不​存在​」）。

docs.title: D2　​資料​集​與​授權
docs.text:
​可以​商用​又​乾淨​的​大型​符號​資料​，​只​找到​ PDMX。 - PDMX ​收錄​超過​ 25 ​萬份​ MusicXML ​樂譜​，​授權​ CC BY 4.0。​有​ 12.29% ​的​曲目​授權​資訊​互相矛盾​，​作者​建議​使用​ no_license_conflict ​子集​（222,856 ​首​）[27]。

​其他​主要​資料​集​都​只能​非​商用​，​或底​層版權​有​疑慮​： | ​資料​集​ | ​內容​ | ​授權​ | |---|---|---| | MAESTRO v3 | 198.7 ​小時​，​鋼琴​ MIDI＋​音訊​ | CC BY-NC-SA [28] | | ASAP | 222 ​份樂譜​對​ 1,067 ​次​演奏​（README ​內​的​數字​不​一致​：222／236、1,067／1,068） | CC BY-NC-SA [31] | | Aria-MIDI | ​從​網路​音訊​轉錄​的​鋼琴​ MIDI [81] | CC BY-NC-SA，​另有​免責​聲明​ [30] | | Lakh MIDI | 17.6 ​萬個​ MIDI | ​資料​集​本身​ CC BY 4.0，​但​內容​是​抓​下​來​的​流行歌​轉譜​，​底層​作品​的​版權​並未​因此​授權​（​推論​）[29] | | Opencpop | ​中文​歌聲​加樂譜​ | ​官方​頁面​是​ CC BY-NC-ND 4.0，​商用​需​另外​寫信​洽談​。​來源​原本​互相矛盾​，​已依​官方​頁面​釐​清​ [32] | | M4Singer | ​中文​多風格​歌聲​ | CC BY-NC-SA，​另附​賠償​條款​ [33] |

​非西方​和​傳統​音樂​：​資料​大多​限非​商用​、​以音​訊​為​主​，​有些​要​申請​才能​取得​。 - ​京劇​（CompMusic）：​不同​紀錄​的​授權​不同​，​有​ CC BY-NC-ND、CC BY-NC ​和​ CC BY [35]。​其中​有​ 120 ​段​唱腔​、1,265 ​句​的​清唱​資料​，​附​ pYIN ​音高​曲線​和​音符​標​註​ [49]。 - ​土耳其​ makam ​的​ SymbTr：​約​ 3,000 ​首​，CC BY-NC-SA [36]。 - ​印度​音樂​的​ Saraga：CC BY-NC-SA [34]。 - ​歌仔​戲​： - ​中研院​團隊​有​一份​「​人聲​片段​＋​歌詞​」​資料​（ISMIR 2025 ​初步​發表​），​沒有​音高​或樂譜層​，​發布​狀態​也​不明​ [37]。 - FT-GAN ​的​ GOAT ​歌仔​戲資料​要​申請​才能​取得​，​授權​是​ CC BY-NC-SA，​並附​賠償​條款​ [38]。 - ​日本​傳統​音樂​：​在​英文​搜尋中​，​唯一​能拿來​做​研究​的​只有​ 9 ​段民謠​錄音​（VocalNotes，CC BY-NC-SA），​而且​要​填申​請表​才能​取得​。​整份​資料​集​含有​敏感​的​儀式​內容​，​作者​要求​不要​重新​彙​整後公開​ [64]（​中​信心​：​來​自​搜尋​摘要​）。 - ​台灣​原住民​音樂​：​中研院​民族所​的​祭儀​歌舞​檔案​有​ 7 ​族​、309 ​個​影音​檔​，​可以​在​線​上​取得​，​但頁​面​沒​有​寫​重用​條款​ [65]。

​法律​現況​：​風險​在​模型​背下​並吐出​訓練​資料​，​不​只是​「​訓練​」​這個​行為​本身​。 - GEMA ​對​ OpenAI ​案​（​慕尼黑​，2025-11）：​法院​判定​模型​背下​歌詞​並在​輸出​中重​現屬​於​侵權​，​而且​文字​與​資料​探勘​（TDM）​的​例外​不​適用​ [40]。​截至​ 2026-07 ​仍​在​上訴​中​ [41]。 - GEMA ​對​ Suno ​案​（​慕尼黑​，2026-07-31）：​法院​認為​「​模型​本身​侵權​」，​責任​在​提供​模型​的​業者​，​符合​ EU AI Act ​也​不能​當作​抗辯​。​判決​尚未​定​讞​ [41]（​中​信心​：​只有​一個​法律​事務​所​的​來源​）。 - ​美國​：2025 ​年​ 10 ​到​ 11 ​月​，UMG ​和​ WMG ​分別​與​ Udio ​和解​，WMG ​也​與​ Suno ​和解​ [42]。

docs.title: D3　​非​十二平均​律​的​表示法
docs.text:
​記譜​格式​在​規格​上​做​得到​，​實際​上​很少​軟體​支援​。 - MIDI 2.0 ​有​逐音​音高​和​ 32 ​位元​的​滑音​（pitch bend）[43]。 - MusicXML ​原生​支援​四分之一​音​，​也​可以​用小數​ <alter> ​表示​更細​的​音高​ [44]。 - MEI ​能區​分​「​寫​的​」​和​「​實際​發聲​的​」​臨時​記號​ [46]。 - ​但​實務上​：​沒​找到​確認​支援​ MIDI 2.0 ​逐音​音高​的​合成器​清單​ [77]；Dorico ​匯出​時會​丟掉​微分​音記號​ [45]，OpenMusic ​匯入​時​也​會​忽略​它們​ [78]（​中​低​信心​：​都​來​自論壇​）。 - ​滑音​和​裝飾音​在​這些​格式​中​，​多半​只能​當作​音符​或​裝飾​記號​處理​。​有​研究者​因此​質疑​「​音符​」​是不是​適合​許多​傳統​的​基本​單位​ [83]（​低​信心​）。

​目前​研究​的​做法​：​把​「​連續​音高​曲線​」​放在​中間​層​。 - ​印度​聲樂​的​ GaMaDHaNi（ISMIR 2024）​是​「​音高​曲線​→​音訊​」​的​兩階段​生成​。​作者​明確​反​對​用​「​粗糙​的​離散​符號​」​來​表示​旋律​ [50]。 - ​京劇​的​資料​集同​時​提供​ f0 ​曲線​和​音符​標​註​ [49]。 - 2026 ​年​有​一篇​預​印本​用​ VQ-VAE ​把​韓國​傳統​音樂​的​裝飾​音曲線​「​學成​」​離散​符號​ [51]。 - ​計算​民族​音樂學​早就​主張​：​把​音高​切成​離散​的​音​，​本身​就是​一種​文化​慣例​ [52]。

​在​地​資料​的​缺口​： - ​工尺​譜​的​光學辨譜​研究​只​在​ 39 ​張圖​上​做過​評估​，​沒有​公開​資料​集​ [47]。 - ​簡譜​沒有​標準​的​評測​資料​，2025 ​年​的​系統​改用​不​需要​大量​訓練​資料​的​傳統​電腦​視覺​方法​ [48]。

docs.title: D4　​音樂​心理​學裡​的​生成​刺激
docs.text:
​已經​有​測驗用​程式​自動​生成​題目​，​但​都​不是​深度​學習​。 - ​旋律​辨別​測驗​（MDT，Sci Rep 2017）​的​做法​ [53]： - ​用馬​可夫​鏈​，​從​愛爾蘭民謠​（Essen ​資料​庫​）​生成​旋律​。 - ​只​控制​ 3 ​個​「​難度​因子​」：​旋律​長​度​、​輪廓​違反​、​調性​違反​。 - ​用解​釋型​ IRT ​校準​難度​，​這​ 3 ​個​因子​能​解釋​難度​變異​的​ adj. R² = 0.869。 - ​共校準​ 1,200 ​題​，​受試者​是​ 158 ​位​成人​和​ 266 ​位兒童​。 - CA-BAT（​節拍​）​和​ MPT（​音準​）​沿用​同樣​的​「​自動​出題​＋IRT＋​適性化​測驗​」​做法​ [54][55]。 - PROMS ​標榜​自己​「​文化​公平​」[56]。

​近年​用​ AI ​音樂當​刺激​的​研究​，​大多​在​問別​的​問題​。 ​它們​多半​測的​是​「​標示​為​人​做​的​還是​ AI ​做​的​，​會不會​改變​聽者​反應​」，​沒有​拿​模型​來​精確​操弄​變因​，​自然​度​的​驗證​也​只​做到​操弄​檢核​ [57]。

​缺口​還在​，​經過​反方​審查​仍然​成立​。 ​在​ 2017–2026 ​年​的​文獻中​做​了​針對性​搜尋​，​沒有​找到​任何​研究​用神經​網路​生成​音樂​能力​測驗​的​題目​，​再用​ IRT ​或​適性化​測驗​校準​難度​。​最​接近​的​有​三個​： - ​一篇​用​ VAE ​生成​相似​度​刺激​、​但​沒​有用​ IRT ​的​研究​（ICMPC 2023）[61] - ​一篇​因為​生成​模型​失敗​、​改用​ Suno ​的​學士​論文​ [62] - ​一篇​「​依目​標難度​生成​鋼琴視​奏​譜​」​的​預​印本​（​教育​用途​，​不是​測驗​）[63]

​西方​中心​的​批評​有​實證​支持​。 - MDT ​的​作者​自己​承認​只用​了​單​一曲​風​ [53]。 - Jacoby ​等​人​在​ 2024 ​年​的​ 15 ​國​研究​發現​，​不同​族群​偏好​的​節奏​比例​不同​，​而學生​和​網路樣​本​的​反應​都​很​接近​美國​聽者​ [58]。 - ​音樂​聽力​測驗​（MET）​在​中國樣​本上​，​之前​並沒有​做過​跨文化​的​信效度​檢驗​ [68]。

​評估生​成品​質​的​方法​還沒有​標準​。 ​評估​方法​的​分類​可以​參考​ ACM CSUR ​的​綜述​ [59]。​主觀​的​聽覺​測驗​沒有​統一​的​實驗​程序​ [79]（​預​印本​，​中​信心​），​客觀​指標​和​聽者​評分​的​相關​也​很​弱​：IS ​是​ 0.25 ​到​ 0.37，FAD ​是​ −0.01 ​到​ −0.16 [60]。

docs.title: D5　​單​旋律​ MIDI ​之​後​的​路線
docs.text:
​現在​的​標準​做法​： - ​用​ MidiTok ​把​ MIDI ​轉成​模型​能讀​的​符號​序列​，​目前​版本​ 3.1.0（2026-09，MIT），​支援​ REMI、CPWord、Octuple、MMM ​等​格式​ [21]。 - ​再接​一個​只有​解碼器​的​ Transformer，​或​改用​ ABC ​記譜​的​文字​模型​。 - ​三個​目標​都​有​開源​的​預訓練​模型​可以​拿來​改​： - ​伴奏​：AMT [12] - ​鋼琴​表情​演奏​：Aria，Apache-2.0，ISMIR 2025（​依​ README，BibTeX ​仍標​為​預​印本​，​未​確認​）[18] - ​作曲家​和​時期​控制​：NotaGen [19]

​算力​： - NotaGen-large ​的​訓練​、​微調​和​推論​都​至少​需要​ 24GB ​顯示​記憶體​。NotaGen-X ​在​本機​推論​大約​ 8GB。​較​小​的​版本​（110M、244M）​需求​更​低​ [19]。 - Aria ​可以​在​ Apple Silicon ​上用​ MLX ​推論​ [18]。 - ​參考值​：MIDI-GPT ​這種​小型​多軌​模型​從頭​訓練​，​大約​要​ 4 ​張​ V100 ​跑​ 2 ​到​ 3 ​天​ [20]。 - AMT、Aria ​和​ NotaGen ​都​沒​有​公布​訓練​所​需​的​ GPU ​時數​。AMT ​和​ Aria ​也​沒​有​附微調​說明​，AMT ​的​作者​把​訓練導​向​另​一套​框架​ Levanter [12][18]。

​一般​ LLM ​不​適合當​核心​生成器​。 - ​在​ ABC-Eval（2025-09，​預​印本​）​上​，GPT-5 ​的​平均分​數約​ 55%。​所有​模型​在​小節​層級​的​任務上​都​失敗​，​辨認​作曲家​和​曲風​也​接近​用​猜​的​ [22]。 - ​用​ ABC ​微調​ LLM ​可以​提升​理解力​，​但會​犧牲​一般​能力​ [23]。 - ​比較​適合​的​用途​是​「​自然​語言​介面​」，​而​不是​生成​音樂​本身​。

​常見​的​坑​： - ​直接​微調​新​的​細部​控制​，​模型​常常​學不會​遵守​。MuseBarControl ​加​了​一個​預訓​練階段​後​，​和弦​正確​率​從​ 65.3% ​提升​到​ 78.3% [24]（​中​低​信心​）。 - ​模型​抄襲​訓練​資料​，​多半​來​自短動​機重​複​出現​ [26]。​檢查​方法​也​有限​：​旋律​式​的​抄襲​檢測​在​多​聲部​音樂​上會​失效​，​要​改用​ SSIMuse ​這類​專門​方法​ [25]。 - FMD ​不是​可靠​的​品質​指標​ [23]。​訓練​損失​也​不​可靠​：​有​研究​發現​，​過擬合​的​模型​聽起​來​反而​更連貫​，​驗證​損失​卻​變差​ [80]（​中​低​信心​）。​聽覺​測驗​仍然​是​基準​。

docs.title: 跨​面向​洞察
docs.text:
• ​授權​決定​了​「​研究​版​」​和​「​產品​版​」​是​兩條​不同​的​路​。 ​把​ D1 ​的​權重​授權​和​ D2 ​的​資料​授權​放在​一起​看​：
  • ​研究​版​可以​用​ MuScriptor、SyMuPe、MAESTRO、​京劇​資料​。
  • ​產品​版​只​剩​ Basic Pitch、YourMT3+（​附​ GPL ​義務​）、ACE-Step、PDMX，​再​加上​自己​錄​製​或​取得​授權​的​資料​ [2][4][5][8][16][27]。​其中​ ACE-Step ​和​ YourMT3+ ​的​訓練​資料​來源​還沒查證​，​商用​前​需要​先確​認​。
  • AMT ​雖然​是​ Apache ​授權​，​作者​自己​也​提醒​輸出​「​應​推定​有​侵權​風險​」[10]。​在​ GEMA ​對​ Suno ​案​之​後​，「​寬​鬆​的​授​權​不​等​於​可以​安全​商用​」​這點​更​明確​了​ [41]。
  • ​最缺​資料​的​文化​，​剛好​也​是​最​需要​曲線​表示​的​文化​。 ​歌仔​戲和京劇​的​公開​資料​最少​（D2），​而​它們​偏偏​最依賴​滑音​和​裝飾音​，​西方​記譜表達​不了​（D3）[37][49][50]。​所以​跨文化​這​一段​，​要​從​自己​採集​資料​和​設計​表示法​開始​，​不能​指望​直接​微調​現成​模型​。​這也​呼應​了​你​想​做​田野​調查​的​願望​。
  • ​評估​方法​本身​就​可以​是​研究​貢獻​。
  • ​客觀​指標​不​可靠​，​聽覺​測驗​又​沒​有​標準​程序​（D4）[60][79]。
  • ​但​你​的​專業​恰好​有​ IRT ​和​心理​計量​的​方法​（D4）[53]。
  • ​加上​模型​會​抄襲​訓練​資料​，​需要​專門​的​檢查​（D5）[25][26]。
  • ​三者​合在一起​，「​用​心理​計量​方法​驗證​生成​刺激​的​可控​度​、​自然​度​和​原​創性​」​本身​就是​一個​方法​學貢獻​。

docs.title: 反證​（​反方​審查​）
docs.text: 結論​ ​判定​ ​最強​的​反方​論點​ ​神經​網路​生成​＋IRT ​是​研究​空白​ ​成立​，​措辭​改為​「​沒有​找到​」 ​馬​可夫​鏈​出題​已​經能​解釋​約​ 87% ​的​難度​變異​；​神經​網路​生成器​沒有​可以​解釋​的​難度​因子​，​可能​反而​削弱​構念​效度​。​所以​必須​說​清楚​神經​網路​生成​「​多帶​來​了​什麼​」，​例如​風格​廣度​和​生態​效度​ [53]。​最​接近​的​既有​研究​見​ [61][62][63]。​這是​審查員​自己​的​推論​，​不是​文獻​結論​。 ​雙層​架構​優​於​直接​生成​音訊​ ​被​削弱​ YuE2 ​中​，​專家​較​偏好​「​一個​模型​同時​寫​譜​和​生成​音訊​」，​勝過​分段​串接​ [70]。​音訊轉​接器​已經能​在​沒​有​符號​層​的​情況​下​控制​節拍​和​音高​ [71]。JASCO ​則​直接​把​符號​形式​的​和弦​和​旋律​當作​條件​，​而​不​另外​生成​符號​層​ [72]。​阿拉伯​ maqam ​有​直接​用​提示​詞引導​音訊​模型​的​例子​ [73]。​民族​音樂學​批評​音符​類別​帶​有​歐洲​的​預設​ [82]，​採譜​研究​也​普遍​預設​五線​譜​是​目標​格式​ [75]。​京劇​歌聲​也​有​只用​音符​、​不用​曲線​就​合成​出來​的​研究​ [76]。​但​目前​沒有​找到​任何​正面​比較​兩種​做法​的​研究​。 ​採用​現成​模型​並微調​，​優​於​從頭​訓練​ ​被​削弱​，​核心​仍然​成立​ 24GB ​只是​ NotaGen-large ​的​下限​，​實際​上​要​改用​中小型​版本​ [19]。NotaGen ​的​預訓練​資料​來源​沒有​公開​ [19]。​西方​偏誤​主要​在​音訊​模型​上​有​實證​，​非西方​資料​只​占​ 5.7% [74]。​用​很小​的​資料​集微調​容易​背下​訓練​資料​。​替代​方案​「​針對​特定​傳統​自訂​表示法​、​從頭​訓練​小​模型​」​說得通​，​但​沒​有​找到​實證​。

docs.title: 建議
docs.text:
1. ​第一步​，​用​ 2 ​到​ 4 ​週做​一個​研究​版​原型​，​涵蓋​「​旋律​→​伴奏​→​演奏​」。
  2. ​用​ AMT ​從​旋律​生​伴奏​ [12]，​再用​ SyMuPe/PianoFlow ​或​ Aria ​做​鋼琴​表情​演奏​ [8][18]。​全部​在​研究​授權​下​進行​。
  3. ​這條​路​直接​接著​你​做過​的​單​旋律​ MIDI，​回答​「​下​一步​」​的​問題​。
  4. ​信心​：​中​高​。​授權​都​已​到​第一手​來源​查證​，​但​能力​只有​部分​查證​：SyMuPe ​的​能力​來​自​搜尋​摘要​，AMT ​和​ Aria ​也​沒​有​微調​說明​。「2 ​到​ 4 ​週​」​是​我​的​估計​，​沒有​來源​。
  5. ​對應​ brief ​的​「​可行性​」​一節​。
  6. ​第二步​，​在​西方​曲風​上​建立​可控​的​題​目庫​，​再用​ IRT ​校準​難度​，​做出​第一篇​論文​的​雛型​。
  7. ​仿照​ MDT ​的​方法​ [53]，​把​「​難度​因子​」​換成​ NotaGen ​的​作曲家​和​時期​條件​ [19]，​或​ MIDI-GPT ​的​屬性​控制​ [20]。
  8. ​一開始​就​設計​好​「​因子​→​難度​」​的​解釋​模型​，​回應​反方​審查​的​效度​疑慮​。
  9. ​信心​：​中​。​目前​沒有​先例​，​這同​時​是​機會​也​是​風險​。
  10. ​對應​研究​計畫​的​「​研究​目標​」​和​「​構想​方法​」。
  11. ​第三步​，​把​跨文化​視為​獨立​的​資料​和​表示法​工程​，​不要​期待​微調​就​能​解決​。
  12. ​先挑​一個​傳統​，​京劇​的​資料​最​完整​ [49]。​用​「​音符​骨架​＋​音高​曲線​」​的​表示法​ [50][51]，​並評​估​合一​模型​這條​路​ [70]。
  13. ​歌仔​戲要​先​和​中研院​團隊​ [37] ​或​ FT-GAN ​團隊​ [38] ​洽談​取得​資料​，​或​自己​做​田野​採集​。
  14. ​歌聲​合成​的​部分​，​改用​ openvpi/DiffSinger ​作為​基礎​：​它​的​程式​碼是​ Apache-2.0，​但​預訓練​模型​和​聲庫​的​條款​還沒查證​ [39]。​不要​用​沒​有​授權​的​ FT-GAN ​程式​碼​ [38]。
  15. ​信心​：​中​低​。​關於​表示法​的​結論​已​被​反方​審查​削弱​，​在​地​資料​也​極少​。
  16. ​對應​研究​計畫​的​「​跨文化​變因​框架​」​和​「​風險​」。
  17. ​一開始​就​決定​是​做​研究​還是​做產品​。
  18. ​產品​版​從​ PDMX、Basic Pitch、ACE-Step ​這類​可以​商用​的​組合​出發​ [5][16][27]。
  19. ​所有​生成​內容​都​要​做​抄襲​檢查​，​例如​ SSIMuse [25]。
  20. ​信心​：​中​。​法律​判決​還在​變動​ [41]。
  21. ​對應​ brief ​的​「​限制​與​風險​」。
  22. ​不要​拿​一般​的​ LLM ​當音樂​生成器​，​只用​它​做​自然​語言​介面​ [22][23]。​信心​：​中​，​因為​只有​單一評​測來源​。

docs.title: 待解​問題
docs.text:
• NotaGen ​和​ AMT ​能​不能​在​少量​非西方​資料​上​微調​成功​？ ​目前​沒有​任何​實作​報告​。​需要​自己​做​一個​小​實驗​，​例如​拿京劇​的​樂譜​ [49] ​試微調​ NotaGen-small。
  • ​雙層​分開​訓練​和​合一​模型​，​哪個​比​較​好​？ ​沒有​找到​正面​比較​的​研究​ [70]。​要​等​ YuE2 ​的​論文​經過​同儕​審查​，​或​自己​做​消融​實驗​。
  • ​歌仔​戲和​原住民​音樂​的​資料​能​不能​取得​、​怎麼​取得​？ ​需要​寫信​洽談​中研院​民族所​ [65]、Li Su ​團隊​ [37] ​和​ FT-GAN ​作者​ [38]，​並​遵循​原住民​同意​相關​的​規範​。
  • ​還沒查​到​的​部分​：
  • ​日​文文​獻裡​的​日本​傳統​音樂​資料​（​英文​搜尋幾乎​沒有​結果​）
  • ​中國​少數​民族​音樂​的​資料​庫​
  • ​美國​著作​權局​的​ AI ​訓練​報告​
  • ​可以​用​ Deepen ​繼續查​，​或​改用​你​自己​的​研究​工具​。
  • ​只有​單一來源​、​尚待​確認​的​說法​： GEMA ​對​ Suno ​判決​ [41]，​以及​ MAESTRO、M4Singer ​和​ Saraga ​的​授權​ [28][33][34]。

docs.text:
​大部分​授權​條款​是​在​ 2026-11-19 ​當天​到​第一手​來源​查證​的​，​但​ SymbTr、Saraga ​和​ Aria-MIDI ​仍​只有​單一來源​或​搜尋​摘要​。​授權​最​容易​變動​，​建議​每個​月​重查​。​依各類​說法​的​有效期限​，​建議​重查​的​時間​如下​：

​類別​ ​代表​說法​ ​建議​重查​ ​授權​ MuScriptor、SyMuPe、ACE-Step、MusicGen、AMT、PDMX、Opencpop、MAESTRO [2][8][11][16][17][27][28][32] 2026-12-19 ​法律​ GEMA ​對​ OpenAI ​上訴​、GEMA ​對​ Suno [40][41] 2027-02 ​評測​和​能力​ MuScriptor F1、ABC-Eval、YuE2、AMT ​和​ NotaGen ​能力​ [1][12][19][22][70] 2027-05 ​資料​集​ ​工尺​譜​和​簡譜​辨譜​資料​、​歌仔​戲資料​ [37][47][48] 2027-11 ​方法​ GaMaDHaNi、MDT、​民族​音樂學​ [50][52][53] 2028-11

recon_kit staleness ​依照​「​發表​日期​」​計算​，​把​ 16 ​條說​法標成​過期​，​其中​大多​是​授權類​。​不過​授權​本身​是​今天​到​第一手​來源​確認​的​，​所以​上表​以​存取​日起算​。​最早​的​重查​日​是​ 2026-12-19（​授權類​）。

docs.title: D1 Landscape and state of the art, round 1 (researcher 1)
docs.text: Accessed 2026-11-19. Budget: 13 tool calls. Two primary pages were read in full: the MuScriptor paper (via the alphaXiv mirror of arXiv 2607.08168v2) and the ACE-Step 1.5 arXiv abstract page. Every other row comes from search-result snippets of primary pages (arXiv, Hugging Face model cards, GitHub), so its confidence is capped at medium. Benchmark numbers are the authors' own figures unless the row says otherwise.

docs.title: Q1 Automatic music transcription (AMT)
docs.text:
• MuScriptor is an open-weight multi-instrument transcription model (Rouard, Krause, Roebel, Simon-Gabriel, Défossez). It comes in 60M, 100M, 300M and 1.3B sizes. It is a decoder-only Transformer that reads 5 s mel windows plus an optional list of instruments and outputs MIDI-like tokens (pitch, timing, instrument). Training ran in three stages: synthetic pre-training on about 1.45M MIDI-rendered clips, fine-tuning on about 170k real recordings (over 11k h), and GRPO-style RL on 300 curated tracks. The paper says the weights and inference code are on github.com/muscriptor/muscriptor, but the paper text states no licence for the code or weights. | MuScriptor: An Open Model for Multi-Instrument Music Transcription | https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2607.08168.md (arXiv 2607.08168v2) | arXiv / alphaXiv mirror | 2026-08 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high (capability), low (licence) | capability/availability | preprint, listed for ISMIR 2026. Peer-review acceptance not verified.
  • On MuScriptor's own test set D_Test, MuScriptor 1.3B scores onset F1 60.4 / frame 73.3 / offset 49.0 / drums 50.2 / multi-instrument 48.2. YourMT3+ on the same set scores 32.5 / 45.5 / 17.8 / 41.4 / 21.9. Per dataset the picture is mixed: YourMT3+ has higher onset F1 on Bach10 (59.8 vs 43.1), Dagstuhl ChoirSet (22.3 vs 14.4) and RWC-Classical. Choral singing is weak for both models (multi F1 2.6 vs 11.5). The paper reports no results on Slakh, MAESTRO or URMP. | same | same | arXiv / alphaXiv mirror | 2026-08 | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium (single source, competitor's own table) | benchmark | preprint
  • YourMT3+ (QMUL) extends MT3 with hierarchical attention, mixture of experts, a multi-channel decoder and cross-dataset stem augmentation. It covers multi-instrument transcription including singing, outputs MIDI, has code on GitHub (mimbres/YourMT3) and a yourmt3 package on PyPI. Its licence was not found. | YourMT3+: Multi-instrument Music Transcription… | https://arxiv.org/html/2407.04822v3 | arXiv / IEEE MLSP 2024 | 2024-07 | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium | capability/availability | peer-reviewed (IEEE MLSP 2024, per the QMUL publication PDF). By the freshness bar this is historical.
  • Piano: Transkun (Yan & Duan) uses a non-hierarchical transformer with interval scoring. It reports state-of-the-art F1 across all MAESTRO subtasks, and its code is public (github.com/Yujia-Yan/Transkun). A transformer piano system from another 2024 paper (Toyama et al.) is reported at note F1 97.4 on MAESTRO, but that figure is self-reported and the source was not opened. Robustness is a known gap: Edwards et al. 2024 show piano AMT models overfit to the acoustics of their training data. | Scoring Intervals using Non-Hierarchical Transformer for Automatic Piano Transcription; A Data-Driven Analysis of Robust Automatic Piano Transcription | https://arxiv.org/html/2404.09466v6 ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.01424 | arXiv (Transkun: ISMIR 2024) | 2024 | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium | benchmark | Transkun peer-reviewed (ISMIR 2024) per the search snippet. Robust-AMT status unverified. No 2025–2026 piano state-of-the-art paper was found, so these are historical.
  • Basic Pitch (Spotify) is a lightweight audio-to-MIDI model for many instruments, released with an ICASSP 2022 paper. It is Apache-2.0 (GitHub repo and HF model card), with Python and TS/JS versions. It outputs MIDI only, not a score. | spotify/basic-pitch | https://github.com/spotify/basic-pitch | Spotify | 2022 (live repo) | accessed 2026-11-19 | high (licence: repo plus HF card agree) | licence/availability | ICASSP 2022 peer-reviewed. Historical by accuracy.
  • Singing voice: no 2025–2026 benchmark leader was established. Candidates are ROSVOT (ZJU, 2024, note-level, code on GitHub, reports about 17% relative pitch improvement over the previous best), a ByteDance Mel-RoFormer vocal-melody transcriber (2025, ISMIR proceedings on Zenodo, claims state of the art and robust offsets, implementation referenced) and SongTrans (2024, joint lyrics plus notes). | Robust Singing Voice Transcription Serves Synthesis; Mel-RoFormer…; SongTrans | https://arxiv.org/html/2405.09940v2 ; https://zenodo.org/record/14877371/files/000049.pdf ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.14619 | arXiv / ISMIR | 2024–2025 | accessed 2026-11-19 | low–medium (snippets only, no F1 tables read) | capability | ROSVOT: ACL 2024 (unverified). Mel-RoFormer: ISMIR 2025 (unverified from snippet).
  • Audio to score (MusicXML), not just MIDI, is still mostly a two-stage process: audio→MIDI, then MIDI→score. Beyer & Dai (ISMIR 2024) convert piano performance MIDI to MusicXML end to end. Zeng et al. (IJCAI 2024) do end-to-end piano audio→score with bar-level key and time signatures. No general multi-instrument audio→MusicXML model was found. | End-to-End Piano Performance-MIDI to Score Conversion with Transformers; IJCAI 2024 862 | https://arxiv.org/html/2410.00210v1 ; https://ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/862 | ISMIR / IJCAI | 2024 | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium | capability | peer-reviewed (ISMIR 2024; IJCAI 2024)

docs.title: Q2 Expressive performance rendering (score→performance)
docs.text:
• SyMuPe / PianoFlow (Borovik et al.) is a framework that tokenises score and performance MIDI and uses flow matching for rendering. It can be steered by emotion text embeddings, and a symupe PyPI package ships rendering and score-performance alignment code. The paper itself notes that models do not yet support real-time interactive inference and that the field is moving toward audio rendering. | SyMuPe: Affective and Controllable Symbolic Music Performance | https://arxiv.org/html/2511.03425v1 ; https://pypi.org/project/symupe/ | arXiv / ACM MM 2025 | 2025-11 | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium | capability/availability | peer-reviewed ACM MM '25 per the search snippet (unverified). Licence not checked.
  • Other 2025–2026 rendering work, openness unverified: Peransformer (APSIPA 2025, score-aware discriminator), joint rendering plus transcription with disentangled style (arXiv 2509.23878), Pianist Transformer (self-supervised on unlabelled MIDI, arXiv 2512.02652), PianoKontext (arXiv 2606.12282), MIDI-VALLE (expressive piano synthesis via codec LM, arXiv 2507.08530), a score→expressive MIDI→neural synth audio pipeline (arXiv 2501.10222) and RenderBox (text plus score→multi-instrument audio, arXiv 2502.07711). All are piano-centric except RenderBox. | search snippets | https://arxiv.org/html/2509.23878v1 ; https://arxiv.org/html/2512.02652v1 ; https://arxiv.org/html/2502.07711v1 ; https://arxiv.org/html/2501.10222v1 | arXiv | 2025–2026 | accessed 2026-11-19 | low | capability | mostly preprints

docs.title: Q3 Controllable symbolic generation
docs.text:
• The Anticipatory Music Transformer (Stanford CRFM) is controllable by infilling, which covers accompaniment of a given melody and the converse. Its weights are on HF (small 128M, large 780M). HF cards and the repo are Apache-2.0. Training data includes Lakh MIDI, and the large card also cites transcripts from FMA and about 450k commercial records. The paper discusses copyright of training data in its appendix, so the commercial position needs checking. | Anticipatory Music Transformer; stanford-crfm/music-large-800k card | https://arxiv.org/pdf/2306.08620 ; https://huggingface.co/stanford-crfm/music-large-800k | Stanford CRFM | 2023 (paper), cards live | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium (licence: HF cards plus repo, both from snippets) | licence/capability | TMLR 2024 (unverified). Seminal but older.
  • Moonbeam (May 2025) is a symbolic foundation model supporting conditional generation and infilling. Code, pretrained model and samples are open-sourced; licence not checked. | Moonbeam | https://www.arxiv.org/pdf/2505.15559 | arXiv | 2025-05 | accessed 2026-11-19 | low–medium | availability | preprint
  • MIDI-RWKV (RWKV-7, adaptable infilling, 2025-06, revised 2026-01) and MIDI-GPT (track- and bar-level infilling with attribute conditioning) were found. Licence and weights are unverified for both. | Adaptable Symbolic Music Infilling with MIDI-RWKV; MIDI-GPT | https://arxiv.org/html/2506.13001v2 ; https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.17011v2 | arXiv | 2025 | accessed 2026-11-19 | low | capability | preprints (MIDI-GPT venue unverified)
  • Text-to-MIDI: Text2midi (AMAAI Lab, 272M) is Apache-2.0 on HF, trained on MidiCaps, with captions covering genre, mood, key, tempo and instruments. MIDI-LLM (Llama-3.2-1B based, Nov 2025) has open code and weights on HF. Its authors claim better quality and text control than Text2midi; this is self-reported. | Text2midi; MIDI-LLM | https://huggingface.co/amaai-lab/text2midi ; https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03942v1 | AMAAI / arXiv | 2024-12 / 2025-11 | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium (Text2midi licence from HF card), low (MIDI-LLM licence) | licence/capability | Text2midi peer-reviewed AAAI 2025. MIDI-LLM at the NeurIPS 2025 AI4Music workshop.

docs.title: Q4 Audio-domain generators
docs.text:
• ACE-Step 1.5 (arXiv 2602.00744, Jan–Feb 2026) uses an LM planner to produce metadata, lyrics and captions, plus a DiT. It offers stylistic control, 50+ languages, lengths up to 10 min, cover generation, repainting, vocal→BGM (accompaniment for a vocal) and LoRA personalisation from a few songs. The abstract does not mention key/scale, BPM, stem or track control, or any MIDI/score output. | ACE-Step 1.5: Pushing the Boundaries of Open-Source Music Generation | https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00744v2 | arXiv | 2026-02 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high (as stated in the abstract) | capability | preprint
  • ACE-Step 1.5 licence: the repo README and HF base model card say MIT. An open HF discussion asks maintainers to confirm that MIT covers the weights and the bundled VAE, and no resolution was found. Treat the weights licence as medium-confidence MIT until the live LICENSE file is checked. | ACE-Step/acestep-v15-base README; HF discussion #27 | https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/acestep-v15-base/blob/main/README.md ; https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5/discussions/27 | ACE-Step / HF | 2026 | accessed 2026-11-19 | medium | licence
  • Audio generators produce audio only. Getting an editable score requires a second step through an AMT model (MuScriptor, YourMT3+, Basic Pitch) and then MIDI→score quantisation. No source found evaluates transcription accuracy on generated audio. | inference from the rows above | n/a | n/a | n/a | accessed 2026-11-19 | low (inference) | method

docs.title: Q5 Integrated toolchain
docs.text: • No single open toolchain was found that combines transcription, symbolic generation and expressive rendering. The nearest partial combinations are joint rendering plus transcription (arXiv 2509.23878, piano, preprint) and SyMuPe (rendering plus alignment tools). | see the rows above | | | | accessed 2026-11-19 | low | availability

docs.title: Leads
docs.text:
1. Contradiction to resolve: YourMT3+ beats MuScriptor on onset F1 on Bach10, ChoirSet and RWC-Classical, but loses badly on MuScriptor's own D_Test. Both sets of numbers come from MuScriptor's table. YourMT3+'s own paper figures on Slakh, MAESTRO and URMP need reading, and MuScriptor needs an independent evaluation.
  2. MuScriptor's code and weights licence: check the LICENSE file at github.com/muscriptor/muscriptor (this is a decision-critical gap). Also find out whether it emits instrument program numbers usable for scoring.
  3. YourMT3 licence (mimbres/YourMT3 LICENSE), Transkun licence and SyMuPe licence and weights.
  4. ACE-Step 1.5 weights licence: is HF discussion #27 resolved? Check the full paper for key, BPM, timbre-reference and stem controls.
  5. Check the other audio generators this round did not cover: MusicGen (CC-BY-NC weights, per prior belief only), Stable Audio Open (community licence, per prior belief only), YuE and any 2026 successors. Re-verify their live licences.
  6. Singing transcription: read the F1 tables in the ROSVOT and Mel-RoFormer (ISMIR 2025) papers and check whether the Mel-RoFormer weights are released.
  7. Style or composer conditioning in symbolic models, e.g. composer tokens in Moonbeam or MIDI-GPT attributes, and models trained on classical corpora such as Aria (EleutherAI) or the GiantMIDI-based ones. Not searched this round.
  8. Audio→MusicXML: is the Beyer & Dai MIDI→MusicXML model released, and under what licence? Also check MuseScore or other tools for score import from MIDI.

docs.title: Looked for, not found
docs.text:
• A 2025–2026 piano transcription paper that clearly supersedes Transkun or the roughly 97 note-F1 class on MAESTRO. The searches returned only 2024 work.
  • Note-level F1 tables for 2025 singing transcription (no snippets with numbers; the SingMelody HF card is unvetted and was excluded).
  • Licence terms for MuScriptor, YourMT3, Moonbeam, MIDI-RWKV, MIDI-GPT, MIDI-LLM and SyMuPe.
  • Any single open model that goes from multi-instrument audio straight to MusicXML or score.
  • Any integrated open pipeline covering transcription, generation and rendering.
  • MIDI or score output from ACE-Step 1.5 (not mentioned).

docs.title: D1/D2 licence verification, round 2, digest 1
docs.text: Accessed 2026-11-19. Sources were checked live through the GitHub REST API (/repos/{r} licence field and raw README/LICENSE files), the Hugging Face API (cardData.license, tags, gated flag), the Zenodo REST API, the official dataset pages, and WebSearch/WebFetch for the legal items. "GH API" means the licence GitHub detected from the repo's LICENSE file. "HF API" means the licence declared in the model card's YAML header.

docs.title: Findings
docs.text:
1. MuScriptor code is MIT. Weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 ("non-commercial use") | muscriptor/muscriptor README "License" section and GH API (MIT) | https://github.com/muscriptor/muscriptor | MuScriptor team (GitHub) | 2026-11 (last push) | accessed 2026-11-19 | high (README, GH API and HF API agree) | licence
  2. MuScriptor weights really can be downloaded. muscriptor-small, -medium and -large are on HF under cc-by-nc-4.0, gated "auto" (access is granted automatically once you accept the licence). The repo holds model.safetensors | HF API | https://huggingface.co/MuScriptor/muscriptor-large | Hugging Face | 2026-07 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | availability. The paper is arXiv 2607.08168, "MuScriptor: An Open Model for Multi-Instrument Music Transcription": preprint, and the abstract says "open-weight" (https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08168). Derived community ports (GGUF, ONNX) carry the same cc-by-nc-4.0 tag.
  3. YourMT3 code: the GitHub repo mimbres/YourMT3 is GPL-3.0 (last push 2024-11) | GH API | https://github.com/mimbres/YourMT3 | GitHub | 2024-11 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence
  4. YourMT3+ checkpoints: the HF repo mimbres/YourMT3 is licence apache-2.0. Its card says it exists "solely to host the model checkpoints of YourMT3+" | HF model card | https://huggingface.co/mimbres/YourMT3 | Hugging Face | 2025-06 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence. Conflict or split: the code is GPL-3.0 and the weights are Apache-2.0. Commercial use is possible, but code you ship together with it inherits GPL obligations. The licences of the training data were not checked.
  5. ACE-Step 1.5 repo is MIT. The README says only "This project is licensed under MIT", followed by a responsible-use disclaimer. It does not split code and weights | GH API and README | https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5 | ACE-Step (GitHub) | 2026-11 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence
  6. The ACE-Step 1.5 weights are also declared MIT on HF: ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 (cardData license: mit, 2026-02) and ACE-Step/acestep-v15-base (mit, 2026-02) | HF API | https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 | Hugging Face | 2026-02 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high (two independent declarations: repo and HF) | licence. No official statement restricting the weights was found. The training-data provenance of ACE-Step 1.5 was not examined this round, and it is the open risk.
  7. AudioCraft: "The code ... MIT ... The models weights ... CC-BY-NC 4.0" (LICENSE_weights file = Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0) | README and LICENSE_weights | https://github.com/facebookresearch/audiocraft | Meta (GitHub) | 2026-03 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence
  8. facebook/musicgen-large on HF is cc-by-nc-4.0 | HF API | https://huggingface.co/facebook/musicgen-large | Hugging Face | 2023-11 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high (agrees with #7) | licence
  9. Anticipatory Music Transformer: code is Apache-2.0 (README: "licensed under the terms of the Apache License, Version 2.0"; GH API agrees). The stanford-crfm/music-large-800k weights are apache-2.0 | GitHub and HF API | https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation ; https://huggingface.co/stanford-crfm/music-large-800k | Stanford CRFM | 2026-07 / 2024-03 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence
  10. AMT training-data provenance (HF card, verbatim): trained "on arrival-time encoded music from the Lakh MIDI dataset, MetaMidi dataset, and transcripts of the FMA audio dataset and 450k commercial music records (transcribed using Google Magenta's ISMIR 2022 ... transcription model)" | HF card for music-large-800k | https://huggingface.co/stanford-crfm/music-large-800k | Stanford CRFM | 2024-03 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | provenance. The weights carry a permissive licence, but the model was trained on transcriptions of commercial recordings. This is a copyright risk for commercial use, and the Apache licence does not resolve it. Only the large-800k card was read; other AMT checkpoints may list different data.
  11. SyMuPe code is Apache-2.0 (GH API). The trained models are on HF: PianoFlow-base, EncDec-base and MLM-base, from the ACM MM'25 collection | GitHub README | https://github.com/ilya16/SyMuPe | GitHub | 2026-05 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence and availability. The SyMuPe paper is arXiv 2511.03425. The README calls it "ACM MM'25", but acceptance was not separately verified.
  12. The PianoFlow-base weights are cc-by-nc-sa-4.0, not gated. The training dataset PERiScoPe is also cc-by-nc-sa-4.0 | HF API | https://huggingface.co/SyMuPe/PianoFlow-base ; https://huggingface.co/datasets/SyMuPe/PERiScoPe | Hugging Face | 2026-05 / 2026-01 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence.   13. MIDI-LLM: the repo LICENSE.md is the full "LLAMA 3.2 COMMUNITY LICENSE AGREEMENT" (GH API reports "Other"). The HF weights slseanwu/MIDI-LLM_Llama-3.2-1B are tagged license:llama3.2 | GitHub LICENSE.md and HF API | https://github.com/slSeanWU/MIDI-LLM ; https://huggingface.co/slseanwu/MIDI-LLM_Llama-3.2-1B | GitHub / HF | 2026-07 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence. Read the full text before relying on it.
  14. Text2midi: code is MIT (GH API, AMAAI-Lab/Text2midi). The weights amaai-lab/text2midi are apache-2.0 (HF API) | https://github.com/AMAAI-Lab/Text2midi ; https://huggingface.co/amaai-lab/text2midi | GitHub / HF | 2025-02 / 2025-01 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | licence. Licence is CC-BY-4.0 and access is open. Description (verbatim, abridged): there is a "discrepancy between the public-facing copyright metadata on the MuseScore website and the internal copyright data", which affects "31,221 (12.29% of) songs". "We recommend using the no_license_conflict subset of PDMX (which still includes 222,856 songs)" | Zenodo API | https://zenodo.org/records/15571083 | Zenodo / PDMX authors | 2025-06 | accessed 2026-11-19 | high | dataset licence.
