docs.title: 過期​地圖
docs.text:
​以下​全都​在​ 2026-11-21 ​對照​各​專案​的​最新​版本​查過​。​工具​腳本​依​「​來源​發布​日期​」​計算​，​九​項裡​有八項​顯示​為​過期​。​這只​代表​ README ​和​ issue ​本身​是​舊​的​，​不​代表​結論​過時​。​版本​相容性​的​有效期限​是​一個​月​，​所以​最​晚​ 2026-12-21 ​前要​開工​，​否則​開工前​重查​一次​：

​說法​ ​類別​ ​重查​時機​ AMT ​的​ transformers ​鎖定​版本​、​沒有​ KV ​快取​ ​相容性​／​效能​ ​開工時​；​留意​ 2026 ​年​的​新​ PR ​是否​合​併​ symupe ​安裝要​補​ numba（issue #9） ​相容性​ ​開工時​ Pianist Transformer ​能​在​ CPU／macOS ​上​跑​ ​相容性​ ​開工時​ SyMuPe ​沒有​開源​情緒​文字​引導​ ​能力​ 2027-02 ​前​ Aria ​只能​續寫​ ​能力​ 2027-02

docs.title: Digest: Aria for expressive rendering, and alternatives (r1-1)
docs.text: Decision served: can the prototype (melody MIDI -> accompaniment -> expressive piano rendering, local on M3 Pro 18GB) use Aria to render expressively, or does it need an alternative? Accessed: 2026-11-21. Sources were fetched with a summarising web fetcher, so "not stated" means the fetched page did not say it, not that it was proven absent.

docs.title: Findings
docs.text:
1. Claim: Aria (base / gen / embedding checkpoints) supports prompt continuation of MIDI, MIDI embeddings and a real-time continuation demo. Its README documents no score-to-performance or "humanize" mode that keeps the given notes.
  2. Source: https://github.com/EleutherAI/aria (README) · EleutherAI · undated (132 commits) · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: high · class: capability
  3. Claim: The official checkpoints are loubb/aria-medium-base, loubb/aria-medium-gen (finetuned for generation) and loubb/aria-medium-embedding, plus a demo checkpoint with sustain-pedal control (model-demo.safetensors). None is described as a renderer.
  4. Sources: https://github.com/EleutherAI/aria ; https://huggingface.co/loubb/aria-medium · EleutherAI / loubb · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: high · class: capability
  5. Claim: Aria ships an MLX implementation for Apple Silicon (demo/demo_mlx.py) alongside PyTorch CUDA. The CLI generate example uses --backend torch_cuda.
  6. Source: https://github.com/EleutherAI/aria · EleutherAI · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: high · class: compat
  7. Claim: Aria's code and models are Apache-2.0. The HF cards say they were trained on the loubb/aria-midi dataset.
  8. Sources: https://github.com/EleutherAI/aria ; https://huggingface.co/loubb/aria-medium · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: high · class: licence
  9. Claim: The Aria paper ("Scaling Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Symbolic Piano Performance", arXiv 2506.23869, ISMIR 2025) evaluates continuations and linear-probe classification, not score rendering. This comes from search snippets only; the full paper was not read.
  10. Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23869 · Bradshaw et al. · 2025-06 · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: med · class: capability
  11. Claim: A GitHub issue search on EleutherAI/aria for "performance OR humanize OR render" returned 0 results. There is no visible community request or fork for rendering in the tracker.
  12. Source: https://github.com/EleutherAI/aria/issues · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: med · class: ecosystem
  13. Claim: MAJEPPA (anusfoil/majeppa) is a LoRA fine-tune of loubb/aria-medium. Its generation mode takes a score MIDI and produces a performance MIDI, conditioned on performer type and recording context. The HF card says Apache-2.0, intended for non-commercial research. The code repo is MIT. Examples use device="cuda", the README says "training code assumes a CUDA GPU", and the repo has 8 commits. The card, README and abstract do not say whether the score notes stay fixed, or whether pedal is output.
  14. Sources: https://huggingface.co/anusfoil/majeppa ; https://github.com/anusfoil/majeppa ; https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11026 (Zhou, Zhang, ..., Dixon; submitted 2026-08-11; ISMIR 2026) · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: med (the capability is claimed, but note fidelity and Mac support are unverified) · class: capability / compat / licence
  15. Claim: Pianist Transformer (yhj137/PianistTransformer, ICML 2026) renders expressive performances from score MIDI, with no MusicXML. It is 135M parameters (about 270 MB) and its weights are on HF as yhj137/pianist-transformer-base and yhj137/pianist-transformer-rendering (also on ModelScope). It outputs pedal (4 pedal points per note) and has a PyQt GUI. The README says a standard CPU is enough for inference and gives a "macOS or CPU-only" install path; MPS is not mentioned. It uses Python 3.11, PyTorch 2.7.1 and Transformers 4.54.0. The code is Apache-2.0; the weights licence is not stated. The repo has 12 commits.
  16. Sources: https://github.com/yhj137/PianistTransformer ; https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.02652 (You et al.; v1 2025-12-02, v2 2026-06-25) · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: high for format, weights and CPU; low for strict note preservation (the per-note pedal points suggest note-level output, but this is unconfirmed) · class: capability / compat / licence
  17. Claim: VirtuosoNet (jdasam) reads a MusicXML score and outputs a performance MIDI. The HAN+GRU checkpoint is on HF at dasaem/virtuosonet. Install is via uv / pip with Python 3.10, plus a download_and_test.py quick test. CUDA 11.8 is named only for GPU use. The repo About section shows no licence.
  18. Source: https://github.com/jdasam/virtuosoNet · Dasaem Jeong · undated (702 commits) · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: high (format, weights); med (CPU viability inferred) · class: capability / compat / licence
  19. Claim: ScorePerformer (ilya16) is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The README offers a Colab demo but no clear downloadable weights. Score/performance alignment and preprocessing code is "deliberately not made available". The input format is not stated. The repo has 4 commits.
    • Source: https://github.com/ilya16/ScorePerformer · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: med · class: licence / capability
  20. Claim: DExter (anusfoil) is a diffusion renderer that takes MusicXML input and is MIT licensed. No pretrained weights are linked (the checkpoint comes from your own training), and the old codec data link is dead. A Colab is offered.
    • Source: https://github.com/anusfoil/DExter · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: med · class: capability / licence
  21. Claim: Newer 2025-2026 rendering works exist without code verified this run: PianoKontext (arXiv 2606.12282, ICML 2026, flow matching in Music2Latent space), "Disentangling Score Content and Performance Style" (arXiv 2509.23878, ICLR 2026), RenderBox (arXiv 2502.07711, text control) and the PianoCoRe dataset (arXiv 2605.06627, github.com/ilya16/PianoCoRe).
    • Source: WebSearch results listing for "expressive performance rendering piano 2026 github" · accessed 2026-11-21 · confidence: low (search snippets only) · class: ecosystem

docs.title: Verdict (for the decision)
docs.text:
• Aria itself: not usable as a note-preserving renderer. Officially it only continues or generates. Feeding a score as a prompt would continue it, not render it.
  • Aria-derived route: MAJEPPA adds score-to-performance on an Aria backbone. It is research-only, CUDA-oriented, and unverified for note fidelity or Mac use.
  • Best-evidenced Mac-local alternative: Pianist Transformer. It takes MIDI in, has downloadable weights, runs inference on CPU (with an explicit macOS install), outputs pedal and is small (135M). Next is VirtuosoNet, which needs MusicXML, so MIDI would have to be converted to MusicXML first.

docs.title: Leads worth chasing
docs.text:
• Pianist Transformer: read the paper (method section) and code to confirm that output notes map 1:1 to score notes and pitches are unchanged. Check the HF card licence for the weights. Test whether MPS works by setting the device.
  • MAJEPPA: read the generate() code or paper for note alignment and pedal tokens. Check whether loading with device="mps"/cpu works, and whether an MLX port via Aria's MLX code is feasible.
  • VirtuosoNet: check the LICENSE file directly (the About section shows none) and the HF card dasaem/virtuosonet. Test CPU inference.
  • PianoKontext and the Disentangling (ICLR 2026) paper: find out whether code or weights are released.
  • ScorePerformer: check whether the Colab pulls downloadable weights.

docs.title: Looked for, could not find
docs.text:
• Any official Aria "humanize" or score-to-performance mode, checkpoint or CLI flag (none in the README or HF listings).
  • Aria GitHub issues about rendering, humanizing or performance (0 results).
  • Last-commit dates for any repo (the fetched pages showed commit counts only).
  • Explicit MPS or MLX support in any renderer other than Aria's continuation demo.
  • Weights licence for Pianist Transformer, and code licence for VirtuosoNet.
  • Magenta or other maintained "humanize MIDI" tools (not searched, because the tool-call budget ran out).

docs.text: Accessed: 2026-11-21 for every source. Code evidence comes from shallow clones of the default branches, grepped without running anything: SyMuPe HEAD 13cc57d (2026-04-30, v1.1.0); anticipation HEAD af37397 (2024-03-18).

docs.title: SyMuPe / PianoFlow
docs.text:
1. Claim: The released inference API takes a quantized score MIDI file (generator.perform_score("score.mid", ...)), a symusic.Score or a TokSequence. MusicXML is converted to MIDI first with partitura_score_to_midi. It needs no aligned performance; alignment (RAScoP/Parangonar) is only for building datasets. A plain melody+accompaniment MIDI is a valid input type. Single-track is assumed (the alignment tools merge tracks by default).
  2. Source: https://github.com/ilya16/SyMuPe (README); https://github.com/ilya16/SyMuPe/blob/main/symupe/inference/performance.py (perform_score docstring, L124-160)

  3. Publisher: Ilya Borovik (GitHub) · pub_date: 2026-04-30 (v1.1.0 commit) · confidence: high · class: capability

  4. Claim: Inference has no CUDA-only dependency. pyproject has no flash-attn, triton, xformers or custom kernels; it needs torch>=2.4.1, accelerate, transformers, miditok, symusic, partitura, parangonar; Python >=3.10. Grepping the source for .cuda( finds nothing. The device is a parameter (AutoGenerator.from_pretrained(..., device=device)). The examples default to "cuda" if available else "cpu". The only other CUDA references are torch.autocast("cuda", enabled=False) in embeddings.py (L668, L732), which only disables autocast, and a guard in trainer.py.

  5. Source: https://github.com/ilya16/SyMuPe/blob/main/pyproject.toml; grep of repo source

  6. Publisher: Ilya Borovik · pub_date: 2026-04-30 · confidence: high (CPU), med (MPS: plausible, but nothing in the docs, tests or issues mentions MPS) · class: compat

  7. Claim: PianoFlow is small, about 24M parameters (8 layers, dim 512). Default sampling is 10 CFM ODE steps (step factor 0.75), in windows (max_seq_len=256, max_new_notes=64, num_samples=8 by default). The paper reports "up to 355 notes per second on a V100 GPU", faster than real time on GPU and "near real time on CPU" (CPU not named). Memory is not reported, but 24M parameters is trivial for 18GB.

  8. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2511.03425v1 ; performance.py signature

  9. Publisher: Borovik et al., arXiv / ACM MM'25 · pub_date: 2025-11 · confidence: med (CPU speed is the authors' qualitative claim) · class: performance

  10. Claim: In the paper, emotion guidance works like this. An MLM-pretrained emotion classifier soft-labels each bar over 33 emotions. A bar's text embedding is a probability-weighted mix of Flan-T5-base embeddings of 16 emotion templates. That embedding, plus tempo and velocity controls, is added before the middle transformer layer, and training uses classifier-free guidance (20% dropout). Only a fine-tuned "control" PianoFlow variant has this.

  11. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2511.03425v1

  12. Publisher: Borovik et al. · pub_date: 2025-11 · confidence: high (that this is what the paper describes) · class: capability

  13. Claim: The released v1.1.0 inference code and the PianoFlow-base model card expose no emotion or text interface. Grepping inference/ and the models for T5/Flan/text_embed/guidance finds nothing. The only controls are cond_seq_control (score-token values such as Tempo/Velocity) and emotion_embeddings hooks inside the model code (no released emotion encoder found). Emotion-text guidance therefore looks unreleased or not usable out of the box.

  14. Source: https://huggingface.co/SyMuPe/PianoFlow-base/blob/main/README.md ; repo grep (performance.py L240-253, music_transformer/inference.py L355, L515)

  15. Publisher: SyMuPe (HF) / Ilya Borovik · pub_date: 2026-04 · confidence: med · class: capability

  16. Claim: Pretrained weights can be downloaded from Hugging Face (safetensors): SyMuPe/PianoFlow-base, EncDec-base, MLM-base and MIDI-Quality-Classifier, all in the "SyMuPe (ACM MM'25)" collection. Install with pip install -U symupe. Weights and data are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; code is Apache-2.0.

  17. Source: https://github.com/ilya16/SyMuPe ; https://huggingface.co/SyMuPe/PianoFlow-base

  18. Publisher: Ilya Borovik / SyMuPe · pub_date: 2026-04 · confidence: high · class: licence

  19. Claim: Known install snags, open since 2026-07-20 (issue #9, still open). import symupe fails because numba is not declared as a dependency. scipy needs upgrading. parangonar's DTW modules raise typing errors. These are workable with a manual pip install numba scipy -U.

  20. Source: https://github.com/ilya16/SyMuPe/issues/9

  21. Publisher: GitHub user report · pub_date: 2026-07-20 · confidence: high · class: compat

  22. Claim: The project is young and thinly maintained: 31 stars, 1 fork, no GitHub Releases. The last commit was 2026-04-30, nearly 7 months before access.

  23. Source: https://github.com/ilya16/SyMuPe
  24. Publisher: GitHub · pub_date: 2026-04-30 · confidence: high · class: compat

docs.title: Anticipatory Music Transformer (AMT)
docs.text:
1. Claim: Core sampling is device-agnostic: anticipation/sample.py moves tensors with .to(model.device), and the anticipation/ package has no .cuda(). Hard-coded .cuda() appears only in the auxiliary scripts humaneval/accompany.py, humaneval/prompt*.py and scripts/eval-loss.py. Those need editing (or just call generate() directly) to run on CPU or MPS.
  2. Source: https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation/blob/main/anticipation/sample.py (L88); grep of repo

  3. Publisher: John Thickstun (GitHub) · pub_date: 2024-03-18 · confidence: high (CPU), med (MPS: no MPS-specific evidence found either way) · class: compat

  4. Claim: requirements.txt pins transformers==4.29.2 (and torch>=2.0.1, mido==1.2.10). Users report that installing transformers 4.29.2 gets stuck on tokenizers 0.13.1 under Python 3.12, and that Python 3.9 fixes it. On Apple Silicon, an old Python or a looser transformers pin is likely needed (the newer pin is untested).

    • Source: https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation/blob/main/requirements.txt ; https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation/issues/19
    • Publisher: J. Thickstun; GitHub user · pub_date: 2025-09-12 (issue) · confidence: high · class: compat

  5. Claim: music-medium-800k has about 360M parameters, a GPT-2 architecture and an Apache-2.0 licence. In fp32 that is about 1.4GB of weights (computed from the parameter count, not measured), which fits easily in 18GB.

    • Source: https://huggingface.co/stanford-crfm/music-medium-800k
    • Publisher: Stanford CRFM (HF) · pub_date: 2023 · confidence: high (params, licence), med (memory estimate) · class: licence / performance

  6. Claim: Generation is slow by design in main. add_token re-runs the full context (up to 1024 tokens) with no KV cache, for each of the 3 tokens per note event. The author has a KV-caching branch (caching) that is not merged ("there could be bugs"). Main is still unmerged as of the 2024-03-18 HEAD. No CPU or MPS speed numbers were found.

    • Source: sample.py L76-108; https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation/issues/15
    • Publisher: J. Thickstun · pub_date: 2024-03-22 · confidence: high (mechanism), low (actual speed on M3) · class: performance

  7. Claim: Melody-conditioned accompaniment is a documented, first-class use. The steps: events, melody = extract_instruments(events, [instr]), then generate(model, start, end, inputs=history, controls=melody, top_p=.98), then ops.combine(accompaniment, melody). The melody must be on its own MIDI program (instrument) so it can be extracted as controls. The README example and humaneval/accompany.py both use a prompt (history), i.e. the first 5 s of real accompaniment.

    • Source: https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation (README L63-83); humaneval/accompany.py
    • Publisher: J. Thickstun · pub_date: 2024-03 · confidence: high · class: capability

  8. Claim: Quality drops without that prompt. A user reports that without a 5-second reference accompaniment "it could barely generate good accompaniment" (issue #18, open, no reply). For a melody-only input, this is a real risk to the pipeline.

    • Source: https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation/issues/18
    • Publisher: GitHub user · pub_date: 2025-04-16 · confidence: med (single report) · class: capability

  9. Claim: You cannot choose the accompaniment's instrument (e.g. force piano). The model picks instruments freely (capped at 16). The author calls instrument conditioning "the most requested feature" and offered a logit-masking hack on an experimental branch. A user reports that the hack gets stuck in repeated notes and zero-duration notes, and the author agreed it is "a bit out of scope for the current models". The issue is still open. For a piano-only accompaniment feeding PianoFlow, expect to post-filter or remap to piano.

    • Source: https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation/issues/9 ; sample.py instr_logits L63-71
    • Publisher: J. Thickstun / GitHub users · pub_date: 2023-12-14 (last comment) · confidence: med · class: capability

  10. Claim: Context and length limits: a 1024-token context (341 events, 3 tokens each) with a sliding "Markov window" (lookback 1017). Training excluded sequences over 100 s, and maximum note duration is 10 s. Long pieces are generated with a sliding window, which limits long-range coherence.

    • Source: https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation/blob/main/anticipation/config.py ; sample.py L80
    • Publisher: J. Thickstun · pub_date: 2024-03 · confidence: high · class: capability

  11. Claim: The repo has been dormant on main since 2024-03-18. Activity in 2026 (PRs #20-#26: "Nanochat Changes", "Span Anticipation", "Symusic Conversion", "Vocab adjustment") suggests next-generation work, but none of it is on main.

    • Source: https://api.github.com/repos/jthickstun/anticipation/issues?state=all
    • Publisher: GitHub · pub_date: 2026-03-16 · confidence: med · class: compat

docs.title: Leads worth chasing
docs.text:
• AMT caching branch (KV cache) for a practical speed-up on CPU/MPS; check whether it is stable.
  • AMT 2026 PRs #24/#25 "Span Anticipation" and #21 "Symusic Conversion": possibly a newer model or vocabulary with instrument conditioning.
  • AMT experimental branch commit 84c4374 (masked_instrs) to force piano-only accompaniment; test whether degeneration still happens.
  • SyMuPe: inspect music_transformer/inference.py emotion_embeddings and check whether any HF repo (beyond -base) ships a control/emotion PianoFlow variant.
  • Hands-on smoke test on the M3 is the only way to confirm MPS: device=torch.device("mps") for both, with PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1.
  • The AMT Colab notebook (linked in the README) for the full accompaniment recipe and the instrument codes it uses.

docs.title: Looked for, could not find
docs.text:
• Any MPS / Apple Silicon report (success or failure) for either SyMuPe or AMT.
  • Measured AMT generation speed on CPU or MPS; measured PianoFlow CPU throughput or memory use.
  • A released emotion-text-guided PianoFlow checkpoint or a text-prompt API in symupe v1.1.0.
  • Explicit documentation that PianoFlow input must be single-track piano; only implied by the piano pitch range 21-108 and the merge-tracks default.
  • Systematic quality evaluation of AMT accompaniment for melody-only input with no accompaniment prompt (the paper's human eval used prompts; this was not checked in the paper this run).

docs.text: 文獻​（​本​專案​取用​的​說法​） ​發表​ ​信心​ AI ​音樂​刺激​研究​以標示​偏誤​為​主​ 2025–2026 ​中​ PIG ​鋼琴​指法​資料​集​與​統計​指法​模型​（Nakamura ​等​人​） 2019 ​高​ Bach Doodle／Coconet 2019 ​低​ ​京劇​歌聲​只用​音符​合成​（DurIAN，​預​印本​） 2019-12 ​中​低​ ​和​聲​一致性​指標​彙​整​；​沒有​「​多生​幾份​再​挑​」​的​伴奏​論文​ 2020–2026 ​中​ Bach or Mock?（ICML 2020 ​工作坊​） 2020-06 ​中​ Jazz Transformer（Wu & Yang，ISMIR 2020） 2020-08 ​高​ MusPy（ISMIR 2020） 2020 ​高​ IS／FAD ChatMusician：​配和聲​用​編輯​距​離評​，​不是​評和聲​品質​ 2024-02 ​高​ MuPT：ABC ​預訓練​模型​，​只會續​寫​ 2024 ​中​ Transkun ​鋼琴​採譜​（ISMIR 2024） 2024 ​中​ Whole-Song ​階層式​生成​（ICLR 2024） 2024-05 ​高​ JASCO：​音訊​模型​直接​吃​和弦​和​旋律​條件​ 2024-06 ​中​ MelodyT5：ABC ​配和聲​、​七​和弦​與​轉位​、1.13 ​億參數​、​訓練​資料​、​指標​比​較​ 2024-07 ​高​ MuseBarControl：​直接​微調​不服​從​控制​（​預​印本​） 2024-07 ​中​低​ YourMT3+（IEEE MLSP 2024） 2024-07 ​中​ ​語言​模型​配和聲​：​專家給​ GPT-4 5.5–6.5 ​分​ 2024-07 ​高​ RubricNet ​鋼琴​難度​ 2024-08 ​高​ GaMaDHaNi ​音高​曲線​階層​生成​（ISMIR 2024） 2024-08 ​高​ GPT-4o ​音程​好​、​辨認​和弦​與​音階弱​ 2024-09 ​低​ ​鋼琴​ MIDI→MusicXML（ISMIR 2024）；​音訊​→​樂譜​（IJCAI 2024） 2024 ​中​ FGG：​取樣​時​擋​掉​調外音​；​沒​看到​授權​ 2025-06 ​高​／​中​ MIDI-GPT ​屬性​控制​、Open RAIL-M、4×V100 2–3 ​天​（​預​印本​） 2025-02 ​高​ Music for All：​非西方​資料​只​占​ 5.7%（NAACL 2025） 2025-02 ​中​ RenderBox ​多樂器​演奏​（​預​印本​） docs.title: 筆記
docs.text:
• ​人聲​和​鋼琴分​在​不同​譜表​，​結構​和​我們​的​任務​相同​：​給​旋律​、​寫​鋼琴​伴奏​。
  • ​專案​方請​使用者​註​明​ OpenScore Lieder ​並附​連結​。​少數​曲子​的​公有​領域​狀態​可能​有誤​。
  • ​用作​參考​範圍​前要​處理​三件​事​：
  • ​篩選民謠​風​的​分節​歌​，​因為​很多​伴奏​比​我們​的​目標​繁​複​；
  • ​只算​人聲​在​唱​的​小節​，​排除​前奏​和​間​奏​；
  • ​驗證​照抄​柱式​和弦​的​候選會​落​在​範圍​外​。
  • 2026-11-22 ​決定​：​原型​ 02 ​的​下​一輪​先​不用​，​之後再​做​小​規模​試驗​。

docs.title: 原型​ 01：​旋律​ → AMT ​伴奏​ → ​表情​鋼琴​演奏
摘要
docs.text:
​問題​： ​把​現成​的​開源​模型​串起​來​，​在​ Mac M3 Pro 18GB ​上​，​能​不能​把​一段​單​旋律​變成​「​願意​拿給​同事​或​老師​聽​」​的​鋼琴​演奏​？

​結論​：​有​條件​成立​。 - ​演奏​層​可用​。 PianoFlow ​和​ Pianist Transformer ​都​在​ Mac ​上​跑​得動​，​也​都​沒​有​改動​任何​音符​。​使用者​的​評價​是​「​差強​人意​，​但是​也​不是​不能​用​」。 - ​伴奏​層不夠​好​。 AMT ​生成​的​伴奏​常有​奇怪​的​和弦​、​和​旋律​對​不​上​、​和弦​進行​難​聽​。 - ​還沒到​放棄​條件​。 ​使用者​判斷​可以​再試​一輪​，​方向​是​先​決定​和​聲​，​再​讓​ AMT ​生​伴奏​（​見​〈​下​一步​〉）。

​主要​的​學習​： 1. 「​拼現​成​模型​」​在​工程​上​是​可行​的​。​三個​模型​、​三個​獨立​的​ Python ​環境​，​用​一個​指令​就​能​串起​來​。 2. ​問題​出​在​控制​：AMT ​沒有​和​聲​的​概念​。​這呼應​研究​計畫​的​「​兩層​架構​」​想法​：​控制​要​放在​符號​層​。

​原型​花​的​力氣​不​代表​正式​版本​要花​的​力氣​。

docs.title: 1. ​背景​與​動機
docs.text:
​使用者​是​研究​音樂​能力​測量​的​音樂​心理​學​研究者​，​過去​做​過單​旋律​ MIDI ​生成​，​之後不​知道​下​一步​。​技術​路線​圖​研究​建議​先​不要​從頭​訓練​，​而是​用​現成​的​開源​模型​拼出​「​旋律​→​伴奏​→​演奏​」​的​流程​，​從​實作​中​累積​經驗​（​路線​圖​研究​ ​建議​ 1）。

​規劃​文件​： - ​原型​計畫​：​要​回答​的​問題​、​放棄​條件​、​範圍​。 - ​模型​查證​：​開工前​查證​ Aria、SyMuPe、AMT ​能​不能​在​ Mac ​上用​。 - ​建置​計畫​：​實作​規格​、​審查​紀錄​。

​動手​前​寫​下​的​放棄​條件​： ​拿​ 3 ​段​不同​風格​的​旋律​跑​完整​條​流程​。​如果​沒有​一段​的​伴奏​和​旋律​搭得​起來​，​或者​演奏​聽起​來​和​直接​播放​ MIDI ​沒有​明顯​差別​，​就​不再​走​「​拼現​成​模型​」​這條​路​。

docs.title: 2.1 ​流程
docs.text:
flowchart LR
  A[​單​旋律​ MIDI] --> B[AMT ​生​伴奏​<br>​旋律​當條件​<br>​只​允許​鋼琴​]
  B -->|​不給​開頭​| C1[​伴奏​ A]
  B -->|​柱式​和弦​開頭​| C2[​伴奏​ B]
  C1 --> D[​合​併​：​對齊​十六分音​符​<br>​合成​一軌​鋼琴​]
  C2 --> D
  D --> E1["① ​直接​播放​（​基準​）"]
  D --> E2[② PianoFlow ​演奏​]
  D --> E3[③ Pianist Transformer ​演奏​]
  E1 & E2 & E3 --> F[FluidSynth + GeneralUser GS → WAV]

​每​段​旋律​產出​ 2 ​種開頭​ × 3 ​個​版本​，​共​ 6 ​組​ MIDI ​和​ WAV。

docs.title: 2.2 ​各步​驟​的​意圖
docs.text: 步驟​ ​做法​ ​為​什麼​ ​輸入​ 3 ​段​公有​領域​旋律​：​快樂頌​（D ​大調​ 4/4，29 ​秒​）、​綠​袖子​（A ​小調​ 3/4，25 ​秒​）、​茉莉花​（F ​五聲​ 2/4，23 ​秒​） ​三種​風格​，​用來​檢驗​放棄​條件​ AMT ​伴奏​ ​旋律​放在​ program 1，​當​ controls；​生成​時​把​鋼琴​以外​所有​樂器​的​ logit ​設成​ −∞ ​讓​ AMT「​看著​」​旋律​寫​伴奏​；​只​允許​鋼琴​，​比較​兩種​開頭​時​才​乾淨​ ​兩種​開頭​ noprompt：​不給​開頭​；chords：​前​ 2–3 ​小節​放​ I–IV–V–I ​柱式​和弦​，AMT ​從​和弦​結束​處​接著​寫​ ​查證​發現​沒有​開頭​時品質​可能​會​掉​（AMT issue #18），​兩種​都​試​，​才​分得出​是​哪個​原因​ ​合​併​ ​伴奏​對齊​到​旋律​的​十六分音​符​格子​，​丟掉​和​旋律​重​複​的​音​，​合成​一軌​ ​兩個​演奏​模型​都​只​吃​「​單軌​、​量化​」​的​鋼琴​譜​；​這一版​直接​播放​就是​基準​ ① ​表情​演奏​ PianoFlow ​和​ Pianist Transformer ​各​演奏​一次​，​參數用​預設值​ ​比較​兩個​候選​，​決定​留​哪個​ ​音符​忠實度​ ​比較​輸入​和​輸出​的​音高​（​依​起音​排序​，​另算​不​看​順序​的​計數​） ​確認​演奏​模型​沒有​偷改​音符​ ​轉音​檔​ FluidSynth＋​使用者​原有​的​ GeneralUser GS ​三個​版本​用​同一​個​音色​，​差別​才​是​演奏​造成​的​ ​試聽頁​ output/player.html，​附盲​聽​模式​ ​方便​自己​比較​，​也​方便​拿​給別​人​聽

docs.title: 2.3 ​環境
docs.text:
• ​機器​：Mac M3 Pro 18GB，​沒有​ CUDA。
  • ​三個​模型​的​相依​版本​互相​衝突​，​所以​各用​一個​獨立​的​ uv ​環境​：AMT ​用​ Python 3.10（transformers==4.29.2），PianoFlow ​和​ Pianist Transformer ​用​ Python 3.11。
  • ​主流程​用子​行程​呼叫​各個​環境​。
  • ​程式​碼​：prototype/melody-to-performance/（GitHub ​分支​ prototype/melody-to-performance）。

docs.title: 3. ​用到​的​模型
docs.text:
模型​ ​角色​ ​授權​（​程式​碼​／​權重​） ​卡片​ AMT music-medium-800k ​伴奏​ Apache-2.0／Apache-2.0 amt SyMuPe/PianoFlow-base ​表情​演奏​ Apache-2.0／CC BY-NC-SA pianoflow Pianist Transformer ​表情​演奏​ Apache-2.0／Apache-2.0 pianist-transformer Aria ​原本​的​候選​，​排除​ Apache-2.0 aria MAJEPPA ​備案​，​沒試​ MIT／​非​商用​研究​ majeppa

​為​什麼​排除​ Aria： ​查證​發現​它​只能​續寫​，​不能​照著​給定​的​譜​演奏​（​模型​查證​）。

docs.title: 4.1 ​能​不能​跑​（​煙霧​測試​，8 ​秒​片段​）
docs.text: 模型​ CPU MPS ​備​註​ AMT ✅ ​每音​ 0.55–0.73 ​秒​ ✅ ​每音​約​ 0.23 ​秒​ ​記憶體​約​ 3GB PianoFlow ✅ ✅（​要​把​ float64 ​轉成​ float32） ​記憶體​約​ 0.5GB Pianist Transformer ✅ ✅ ​記憶體​約​ 0.6GB

docs.title: 4.3 ​觀察
docs.text:
• ​兩個​演奏​模型​都​沒​有​改​音符​。 6 ​個​伴奏​、12 ​次​演奏​，​音高​計數​和​輸入​完全相同​。
  • PianoFlow ​不看​譜​上​的​速度​。 ​同​一份​譜設​ 60 ​或​ 240 bpm，​輸出​一樣​長​。​快樂頌​被​彈慢​最多​ 3.4 ​倍​，​茉莉花​反而​稍快​。
  • Pianist Transformer ​通常​比​原速​快​ 10–30%。
  • AMT ​自己​挑樂器​。 ​第一次​執行​時​，​不給​開頭​的​版本​挑​了​大鍵琴​、​吉他​、​直笛​、​小提琴​、​電貝斯​。​改成​生成​時​只​允許​鋼琴​後​，6 ​份​伴奏​全是​鋼琴​，​也​沒​有​零長​度​音符​。
  • ​只用​鋼琴​又​不給​開頭​時​，​有重​複​單一音​的​傾向​。 ​快樂頌​ 28 ​個​伴奏​音裡​有​ 46% ​是​同一​個​音高​；​綠​袖子​和​茉莉花​約​三成​。​給​和弦​開頭​的​版本​只有​ 12–15%。
  • ​給​和弦​開頭​的​版本​，​限定​鋼琴​前後結果​相同​：AMT ​本來​就​跟​著​開頭​的​樂器​走​，​隨機​種子​也​一樣​。

docs.title: 4.4 ​使用者​的​聽感​（2026-11-21）
docs.text:
• ​伴奏​： 「​生成​的​伴奏​品質​都​不是​很​好​。​有​的​時候​會​有​奇怪​的​和弦​，​或是​對​不​上​，​或是​和弦​的​進行​很​難​聽​。」
  • ​演奏​： 「​兩個​演奏​模型​，​表現​都​是​差強​人意​，​但是​也​不是​不能​用​。」
  • ​判斷​： ​還​不到​ AMT ​的​放棄​條件​，​可以​再試​一輪​。

docs.title: 5. ​討論​：​伴奏​為​什麼​不好
docs.text:
​以下​是​推論​，​還沒驗證​。

​我們​自己​造成​的​： - ​開頭​和弦​寫死成​ I–IV–V–I，​沒有​看​旋律​，​前​幾小節​可能​和​旋律​打架​。 - ​為​了​讓​演奏​模型​吃得下​，​伴奏​被​硬​對​齊到​十六分音​符​格子​。AMT ​原本​以​ 10 ​毫秒​為​單位​，​對齊​可能​把音​推到​錯​的​拍子​上​，​這​可能​是​「​對​不​上​」​的​一部分​原因​。 - ​限定​只用​鋼琴​，​改變​了​ AMT ​原本​的​取樣​分布​。 - ​上游​ generate() ​會​丟掉​前​ 50 ​毫秒​的​控制​音​，​所以​從​第​ 0 ​秒​開始​的​旋律​第一​個音​，AMT ​看不到​。

​模型​本身​的​限制​： - AMT ​是​ 2023 ​年​的​模型​，​主要​訓練​資料​是​流行歌​轉成​的​多樂器​ MIDI（Lakh MIDI ​等​）。 - ​它​沒​有​「​和​聲​」​這個​概念​，​只會​從​統計​上​猜​下​一個音​。​沒​有人​告訴​它​這​一小​節該​用​什麼​和弦​。

​和文​獻的關​係​： - ​直接​要​一般​語言​模型​寫​音符​，​效果​很差​（ABC-Eval）。 - ​有​顯式​的​樂譜​或​規劃層​，​確實​有助​於​控制​（YuE2，​預​印本​）。

docs.title: 6. ​下​一步​（2026-11-21 ​與​使用者​討論​的​結果​）
docs.text:
1. ​原型​ 02：​先定​和​聲​，​再生​伴奏​，​多生​幾份​挑​最好​的​。
  2. ​先替​旋律​配好​和弦​（​由​語言​模型​或​規則​程式​負責​），​把​和弦​當成​ AMT ​的​條件​，​讓​ AMT ​只​負責​把​和​聲​「​彈成​伴奏​」。
  3. ​每段​生​多份​伴奏​，​用​程式​算​和​旋律​的​協​和​程度​，​留​最好​的​。
  4. ​前提​是​和​聲標​記要​正確​。​使用者​說​：「​先用​這個​方向​去​做​看看​，​先​不要​太​ critical。」
  5. ​研究​（Mary）： ​查​更好​的​伴奏​生成​模型​，​以及​配和聲​模型​。​結果​要​累積進​這個​知識庫​。
  6. ​暫不微調​。
  7. ​演奏​層​先維持​原樣​。

docs.title: 7. ​已知​限制​與​待解​問題
docs.text:
• ​參數​全部​用​預設值​，​每種​條件​只​取樣​一次​（seed 0）。​結果​帶​有​隨機性​，​沒有​重​複​取樣​。
  • ​只有​使用者​一個​人​聽過​，​還沒有​盲​聽​，​也​沒​有​拿​給別​人​聽​。
  • PianoFlow ​的​速度​問題​會​影響​演奏​版之間​的​比​較​。
  • GeneralUser GS ​和​ MS Basic ​的​授權​沒有​查證​。
  • setup.sh ​在​權重​遺失​時​的​錯誤​處理​沒有​實際觸​發過​。

docs.title: 8. ​重現​方式
docs.text:
git checkout prototype/melody-to-performance
cd prototype/melody-to-performance
./setup.sh
uv run smoke_test.py
uv run run.py examples/ode_to_joy.mid     # ​綠​袖子​、​茉莉花​同理​
uv run make_player.py && open output/player.html

docs.title: AccoMontage
docs.text: 項目​ ​內容​ ​做什麼​ ​伴奏​（​旋律​＋​和弦​ → ​鋼琴​） ​連結​ GitHub ​程式​碼​授權​ MIT ​權重​授權​ ​資料​與​權重​在​ Google Drive（​授權​未標​） ​大小​ ​檢索​＋​小型​ VAE ​輸入​ MIDI ​旋律​＋​和弦​（​拍為​單位​，​可到​九​和弦​） ​輸出​ ​鋼琴​ MIDI（​含​力度​、​踏板​） Mac（M3 Pro 18GB） README ​沒提​ CUDA（​未驗證​） ​我們​的​使用​狀態​ ​原型​ 02 ​候選​ ​實測​效能​ —

docs.title: 重點​與​坑
docs.text: • ISMIR 2021。​從​ POP909 ​樂句​庫檢索​再​做​風格​轉換​。

docs.title: 更新​紀錄
docs.text:
• ​原型​ 02（2026-11-21）： ​在​ Mac CPU ​上​跑​成功​（​加​了​ map_location、Tensor.cuda ​空​操作​兩個​小補丁​）。​只​支援​ 4/4：​綠​袖子​（3/4）、​茉莉花​（2/4）​要​重新​分成​ 4 ​拍​一小​節​。8 ​份要​不同​，​需要​把​樂句​選擇​隨機度​設為​ 0.1。​伴奏​密度​高​（​每​段​ 100–350 ​個音​），​和弦音​比例​ 0.91–0.99。
  • ​論​文精​讀​（2026-11-22）： POP909 ​只留​ 2/4、4/4 → 857 ​首​、11,032 ​樂句​，​並移​到​ 12 ​個調​。​挑樂句​：​每句​合​不合​（​節奏​ 0.5 ＋ ​調性​區間​向量​ 0.5，​規則式​）× 0.3 ＋ ​上下​句​接得​順不順​（​對​比學習​）× 0.7，​再用​ Viterbi ​解​；​和弦​是​刻意​的​弱​條件​，​事後由​「​和弦​與織體​拆開​」​的​ VAE（Wang 2020，POP909）​改​和弦​。​密度​與​發聲數​只​篩​第一句​（​論文分​三級​）。​評估​：72 ​人​、14 ​首​ Nottingham ​民謠​、5 ​分量​表​，​連貫​與​結構​顯著​較​好​；​沒有測​可彈性​。​模型​來歷​報告​

docs.title: AccoMontage2
docs.text: 項目​ ​內容​ ​做什麼​ ​配和聲​＋​伴奏​（​只給​旋律​） ​連結​ GitHub ​程式​碼​授權​ MIT ​權重​授權​ ​資料​檔​在​ Google Drive ​大小​ ​檢索​＋​動態​規劃​ ​輸入​ MIDI ​旋律​＋​主音​＋​樂句​切分​ ​輸出​ ​和弦​ MIDI＋​伴奏​ MIDI Mac（M3 Pro 18GB） README ​沒提​ GPU；​有​網頁​介面​ ​我們​的​使用​狀態​ ​原型​ 02 ​候選​ ​實測​效能​ —

• ISMIR 2022。​只​支援​ 4/4，​樂句​ 4 ​或​ 8 ​小節​。

docs.text: • ​原型​ 02（2026-11-21）： ​在​ Mac CPU ​上​跑​成功​；​只配​和​聲​的​路徑​上游​會當​掉​（__add_textures() ​缺​ log），​加​了​小​補丁​。​綠​袖子​（3/4）​不​支援​。

docs.text: 項目​ ​內容​ ​做什麼​ ​符號​生成​：​補寫​、​給​旋律​生​伴奏​ ​連結​ GitHub、HF music-medium-800k ​程式​碼​授權​ Apache-2.0 ​權重​授權​ Apache-2.0（​訓練​資料​ Lakh MIDI ​多為​翻扒​商業​歌曲​，​作者​提醒​輸出​應​推定​有​侵權​風險​） ​大小​ small／medium ​約​ 3.6 ​億參數​／large ​輸入​ MIDI ​事件​（time, dur, note）；controls= ​當條件​ ​輸出​ ​多樂器​ MIDI Mac（M3 Pro 18GB） ✅ CPU、MPS ​都​能​跑​（prototype-01 ​實測​） ​我們​的​使用​狀態​ ​已用​於​ prototype-01 ​實測​效能​ medium ​在​ M3 Pro CPU：​一段​ 25–30 ​秒​旋律​ 30–250 ​秒​，​記憶體​約​ 3.4GB；MPS ​每音​較​快

docs.title: 重點​與​坑
docs.text:
• ​主​分支​沒有​ KV ​快取​，​很​慢​；transformers==4.29.2 ​在​ Python 3.12 ​裝不起​來​，​用​ 3.10。
  • ​輔助​腳本​寫​死​ .cuda()，​直接​呼叫​ generate()。
  • ​沒有​伴奏​開頭​時品​質會​掉​（issue #18）；​控制​音在​前​ 50 ​毫秒​會​被​丟掉​。
  • ​不能​指定​樂器​；prototype-01 ​用​ logit ​遮罩​限定​只​寫​鋼琴​，​可行​但​「​不給​開頭​」​時易重​複​單音​。
  • ​沒有​和​聲​概念​，​使用者​評​：​和弦​怪​、​對​不​上​、​進行​難​聽​。
  • ​不是​為​「​旋律​＋​和弦​ → ​鋼琴​伴奏​」​設計​的​；​那​是​ POP909 ​系列​模型​的​標準​任務​（accomontage、polyffusion、d3pia），​見​ R3。

docs.title: 更新​紀錄
docs.text:
• ​原型​ 02（2026-11-21）： ​加上​柱式​和弦​當額外​條件​（program 48）。64 ​份裡​ 12 ​份​是​空​的​；​常​把​旋律​原樣​、​高​八度​或​平行​三度​抄​一遍​（​旋律​放在​鋼琴類​音色​、​輸出​限定​鋼琴時​）。​舊​的​挑選​指標​（​含​ PCS）​會​挑到​這些​抄​的​；​已​改成​排除​抄​旋律​ ≥ 50% ​的​候選​。MPS ​約​每份​ 1 ​分鐘​，CPU ​加​和弦​條件​ 5–8 ​分鐘​。
  • ​論​文精​讀​（2026-11-22）： ​訓練​資料​是​ Lakh MIDI（178,561 ​檔​、​約​ 8,943 ​小時​、​多樂器​，​以​西方​流行​為主​），​先前​寫​的​「45 ​萬張​唱片​轉譜​」​是​錯​的​。​時間​以​ 10 ​毫秒​為​單位​，​沒有​小節​與​拍子​；​條件​音​提前​ 5 ​秒​放進​序列​。​訓練​時​挑​條件​的​比例​：10% ​不​挑​、10% ​時間​片段​、40% ​整件​樂器​、40% ​隨機音​；​擴增​ 30 ​倍​，​約​ 520 ​億符號​。Medium 3.6 ​億參數​、80 ​萬步​（​我們​用​的​版本​）。​伴奏​評估​：​旋律​定義為​最高​音​的​樂器​，​有​ 5 ​秒​開頭​，Mechanical Turk A/B，​對​真人​ 18 ​勝​ 31 ​平​ 11 ​負​（p = 0.19）。​模型​來歷​報告​

docs.title: 更新​紀錄
docs.text:
• R4（2026-11-21）： Embellish ​推論​只​寫​了​ CUDA；README ​說​的​ inference_gpt2.py ​不​存在​（404）；​輸入​是​ REMI ​事件​文字​檔​，​要​自己​寫​轉換​。R4 ​結論​：​在​ Mac ​上要​改​的​地方​太​多​，​這輪​不加​。[R4 [3]]
  • ​原型​ 02 ​第三​輪​（2026-11-22）： ​實際裝​起來​了​。
  • ​只用​第二​階段​ Embellish（GPT-2 ​版​，​權重​ 379MB）；​第一​階段​「​自己​寫​旋律​＋​和弦​」​換成​我們​的​旋律​與​和弦​表​。
  • ​自己​寫​了​ lead sheet ​轉換​（Bar／Beat／Chord／Note ​事件​，​每小節​ 16 ​格​，​照訓練​資料​的​順序​）​和​取樣​迴​圈​（​上游​ inference.py ​一載入​就​呼叫​ CUDA，​不能​直接​用​）。
  • ​載入權​重要​：​詞​彙​表多算​一個​ PAD（367），​並​丟掉​舊版​ transformers ​的​注意力​遮罩​ buffer。
  • ​模型​會​把​旋律​一起​彈出​來​，​而且​幾乎​一音​不差​（​快樂頌​ 62/62、​綠​袖子​ 38/38）；​轉換​時​把​旋律​音​拿掉​，​只留​伴奏​。
  • ​和弦​只有​ 11 ​種性質​，​其他​和弦​就近​對應​，​轉位​的​低音​被​丟掉​。​只​吃​ 4/4，​綠​袖子​（3/4）​重新​併​成​ 4 ​拍​一小​節​。
  • ​第三​輪​ 4 ​格共​ 32 ​份​，​全部​通過​新​指標​的​五道​門檻​；​伴奏​偏​稀疏​（​中位​數約​ 72 ​個音​），​還沒​聽過​。
  • ​論​文精​讀​（2026-11-22）： Pop1K7 ​約​ 1,700 ​首​西方​、​日​、​韓​流行​鋼琴​翻奏​，​由音​檔​自動​採譜​（Kong ​等​人​的​模型​）；​清理​後​ 1,591 ​首​。​樂譜​由​ skyline ​抽​旋律​（​約​八成​準確​）​加上​自動​分析​的​和弦​與​樂句​。​第一​階段​另用​ Lakh MIDI 14,934 ​首預​訓練​（​我們​沒用​）。​第二​階段​一小​節樂譜​、​一小​節​演奏​交錯​，12 ​層​、38M ​參數​，​截​ 3,072 ​符號​訓練​，​約​ 3 ​天​。​論​文版​是​ Performer；GPT-2 ​版同​資料​、​同​大小​。​作者​給​第二​階段​的​取樣​值​是​溫度​ 1.1、top_p 0.99（1.2／0.97 ​是​第一​階段​的​值​）。​旋律​符合率​超過​ 98%。​評估​：15 ​人​、​整首​從​零寫​，​整體​ 3.18 ​分​，​真人​ 4.40 ​分​。​模型​來歷​報告​

• 2026-11-16 ​發布​，​沒有​論文​；HookTheory（Sheet Sage ​版​）​訓練​，transformer ​先​預訓練​再​用​強化​學習​微調​；​三個​版本​ base／smooth／chromatic。
  • ​支援​ 2/4、3/4、6/8 ​等​拍子​（​拍號​分母​ 4 ​或​ 8；​見​程式​碼​ meter.py，README ​沒寫​）；​拍號​改變​時​分段​；​一次​最​多​ 32 ​小節​，​更長​用​重疊視​窗​；​整首​只有​一個​調​。
  • ​可以​只​重配​指定​小節​，​其他​保留​；​有​ temperature、seed ​參數​，​適合系​統性​調參​。
  • ​自報​評估​：​調外​和弦​時間​ base 6.9%、smooth 5.5%、chromatic 12.9%（​人類​ 9.6%）；​聽覺​測試​只有​ 1 ​位​聽者​。
